vulg: placuit ergo sermo coram Domino quod Salomon rem huiuscemodi postulasset
clem: Placuit ergo sermo coram Domino, quod Salomon postulasset hujuscemodi rem.
kjv: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֵלָיו יַעַן אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַלְתָּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ יָמִים רַבִּים וְלֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ עֹשֶׁר וְלֹא שָׁאַלְתָּ נֶפֶשׁ אֹיְבֶיךָ וְשָׁאַלְתָּ לְּךָ הָבִין לִשְׁמֹעַ מִשְׁפָּט ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν Κύριος πρὸς αὐτόν Ἀνθ’ ὧν ᾐτήσω παρ’ ἐμοῦ τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο, καὶ οὐκ ᾐτήσω σαυτῷ ἡμέρας πολλὰς καὶ οὐκ ᾐτήσω πλοῦτον οὐδὲ ᾐτήσω ψυχὰς ἐχθρῶν σου, ἀλλ’ ᾐτήσω σαυτῷ τοῦ συνιεῖν τοῦ εἰσακούειν κρίμα·
vulg: et dixit Deus Salomoni quia postulasti verbum hoc et non petisti tibi dies multos nec divitias aut animam inimicorum tuorum sed postulasti tibi sapientiam ad discernendum iudicium
clem: Et dixit Dominus Salomoni: Quia postulasti verbum hoc, et non petisti tibi dies multos, nec divitias, aut animas inimicorum tuorum, sed postulasti tibi sapientiam ad discernendum judicium:
kjv: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;

wlc: הִנֵּה עָשִׂיתִי כִּדְבָרֶיךָ הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לְךָ לֵב חָכָם וְנָבוֹן אֲשֶׁר כָּמוֹךָ לֹא־הָיָה לְפָנֶיךָ וְאַחֲרֶיךָ לֹא־יָקוּם כָּמוֹךָ ׃
lxx: ἰδοὺ πεποίηκα τό ῥῆμά σου· ἰδοὺ δέδωκά σοι καρδίαν φρονίμην καὶ σοφήν· ὡς ςὺ οὐ γέγονεν ἔμπροσθέν σου, καὶ μετὰ σὲ οὐκ ἀναστήσεται ὅμοιός σοι.
vulg: ecce feci tibi secundum sermones tuos et dedi tibi cor sapiens et intellegens in tantum ut nullus ante te similis tui fuerit nec post te surrecturus sit
clem: ecce feci tibi secundum sermones tuos, et dedi tibi cor sapiens et intelligens, in tantum ut nullus ante te similis tui fuerit, nec post te surrecturus sit.
kjv: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.

wlc: וְגַם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁאַלְתָּ נָתַתִּי לָךְ גַּם־עֹשֶׁר גַּם־כָּבוֹד אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיָה כָמוֹךָ אִישׁ בַּמְּלָכִים כָּל־יָמֶיךָ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἃ οὐκ ᾐτήσω δέδωκά σοι, καὶ πλῦτον καὶ δόξαν, ὡς οὐ γέγονεν ἀνὴρ ὅμοιός σοι ἐν βασιλεῦσιν·
vulg: sed et haec quae non postulasti dedi tibi divitias scilicet et gloriam ut nemo fuerit similis tui in regibus cunctis retro diebus
clem: Sed et hæc quæ non postulasti, dedi tibi: divitias scilicet, et gloriam, ut nemo fuerit similis tui in regibus cunctis retro diebus.
kjv: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.

wlc: וְאִם תֵּלֵךְ בִּדְרָכַי לִשְׁמֹר חֻקַּי וּמִצְוֹתַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ דָּוִיד אָבִיךָ וְהַאַרַכְתִּי אֶת־יָמֶיךָ ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἐὰν πορευθῇς ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ μου φυλάσσειν τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ τὰ προστάγματά μου ὡς ἐπορεύθη Δαυεὶδ ὁ πατήρ σου, καὶ πληθυνῶ τὰς ἡμέρας σου.
vulg: si autem ambulaveris in viis meis et custodieris praecepta mea et mandata mea sicut ambulavit pater tuus longos faciam dies tuos
clem: Si autem ambulaveris in viis meis, et custodieris præcepta mea et mandata mea, sicut ambulavit pater tuus, longos faciam dies tuos.
kjv: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.

wlc: וַיִּקַץ שְׁלֹמֹה וְהִנֵּה חֲלוֹם וַיָּבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלַםִ וַיַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־אֲדֹנָי וַיַּעַל עֹלוֹת וַיַּעַשׂ שְׁלָמִים וַיַּעַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּה לְכָל־עֲבָדָיו ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἐξυπνίσθη Σαλωμών, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐνύπνιον· καὶ ἀνέστη καὶ παργίνεται εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, καὶ ἔστη κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τοῦ κατὰ πρόσωπον κιβωτοῦ διαθήκης Κυρίου ἐν Σειών, καὶ ἀνήγαγεν ὁλοκαυτώσεις καὶ ἐποίησεν εἰρηνικάς, καὶ ἐποίησεν πότον μέγαν ἑαυτῷ καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς παισὶν ἑαυτοῦ.
vulg: igitur evigilavit Salomon et intellexit quod esset somnium cumque venisset Hierusalem stetit coram arca foederis Domini et obtulit holocausta et fecit victimas pacificas et grande convivium universis famulis suis
clem: Igitur evigilavit Salomon, et intellexit quod esset somnium: cumque venisset Jerusalem, stetit coram arca fœderis Domini, et obtulit holocausta, et fecit victimas pacificas, et grande convivium universis famulis suis.
kjv: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

wlc: אָז תָּבֹאנָה שְׁתַּיִם נָשִׁים זֹנוֹת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה לְפָנָיו ׃
lxx: Τότε ὤφθησαν δύο γυναὶκες πόρναι τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ ἔστησαν ἐνώπιον αὐτοὺ.
vulg: tunc venerunt duae mulieres meretrices ad regem steteruntque coram eo
clem: Tunc venerunt duæ mulieres meretrices ad regem, steteruntque coram eo:
kjv: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.

wlc: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הָאַחַת בִּי אֲדֹנִי אֲנִי וְהָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת יֹשְׁבֹת בְּבַיִת אֶחָד וָאֵלֵד עִמָּהּ בַּבָּיִת ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν ἡ γυνὴ ἡ μία Ἐν ἐμοί, κύριε· ἐγὼ καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αἥτη οἰκοῦμεν ἐν οἴκῳ ἐνί, καὶ ἐτέκομεν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ·
vulg: quarum una ait obsecro mi domine ego et mulier haec habitabamus in domo una et peperi apud eam in cubiculo
clem: quarum una ait: Obsecro, mi domine: ego et mulier hæc habitabamus in domo una, et peperi apud eam in cubiculo.
kjv: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.

wlc: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לְלִדְתִּי וַתֵּלֶד גַּם־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת וַאֲנַחְנוּ יַחְדָּו אֵין־זָר אִתָּנוּ בַּבַּיִת זוּלָתִי שְׁתַּיִם־אֲנַחְנוּ בַּבָּיִת ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐγεηήθη ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ τεκούσης μου καὶ ἔτεκεν καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αἥτη· καὶ ἡμεῖς κατὰ τὸ αὐτό, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν οὐθεὶς μεθ’ ἡμῶν παρὲξ ἀμφοτέρων ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ.
vulg: tertia vero die postquam ego peperi peperit et haec et eramus simul nullusque alius in domo nobiscum exceptis nobis duabus
clem: Tertia autem die postquam ego peperi, peperit et hæc: et eramus simul, nullusque alius nobiscum in domo, exceptis nobis duabus.
kjv: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.

wlc: וַיָּמָת בֶּן־הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת לָיְלָה אֲשֶׁר שָׁכְבָה עָלָיו ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπέθανεν ὁυίὸς τὴς γυναικὸς ταύτης τὴν νύκτα, ὠς ἐπεκοιμήθη ἐπ’ αὐτόν·
vulg: mortuus est autem filius mulieris huius nocte dormiens quippe oppressit eum
clem: Mortuus est autem filius mulieris hujus nocte: dormiens quippe oppressit eum.
kjv: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlaid it.

wlc: וַתָּקָם בְּתוֹךְ הַלַּיְלָה וַתִּקַּח אֶת־בְּנִי מֵאֶצְלִי וַאֲמָתְךָ יְשֵׁנָה וַתַּשְׁכִּיבֵהוּ בְּחֵיקָהּ וְאֶת־בְּנָהּ הַמֵּת הִשְׁכִּיבָה בְחֵיקִי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀνέστη μέσης τῆς νυκτὸς καὶ ἔλαβεν τὸν υἱόν μου ἐκ τῶν ἀγκαλῶν μου καὶ ἐκοίμισεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ αὐτῆς, καὶ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν τεθνηκότα ἐκοίμισεν ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ μου.
vulg: et consurgens intempesta nocte silentio tulit filium meum de latere meo ancillae tuae dormientis et conlocavit in sinu suo suum autem filium qui erat mortuus posuit in sinu meo
clem: Et consurgens intempestæ noctis silentio, tulit filium meum de latere meo, ancillæ tuæ dormientis, et collocavit in sinu suo: suum autem filium, qui erat mortuus, posuit in sinu meo.
kjv: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

wlc: וָאָקֻם בַּבֹּקֶר לְהֵינִיק אֶת־בְּנִי וְהִנֵּה־מֵת וָאֶתְבּוֹנֵן אֵלָיו בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה לֹא־הָיָה בְנִי אֲשֶׁר יָלָדְתִּי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀνέστην τὸ πρωὶ θηλάσαι τὸν υἱόν μου, καὶ ἐκεῖνος ἦν τεθνηκώς· καὶ ἰδοὺ κατενόησα αὐτὸν πρωί, καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐκ ἦν ὁ υἱός μου ὃν ἔτεκον.
vulg: cumque surrexissem mane ut darem lac filio meo apparuit mortuus quem diligentius intuens clara luce deprehendi non esse meum quem genueram
clem: Cumque surrexissem mane ut darem lac filio meo, apparuit mortuus: quem diligentius intuens clara luce, deprehendi non esse meum quem genueram.
kjv: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.

wlc: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הָאַחֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנִי הַחַי וּבְנֵךְ הַמֵּת וְזֹאת אֹמֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנֵךְ הַמֵּת וּבְנִי הֶחָי וַתְּדַבֵּרְנָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν ἡ γυνὴ ἠ ἐτέρα Οὐχί, ἀλλὰ ὁ υἰός μου ὁ ζῶν, ὁ δὲ υίός σου ὁ τεθνηκως· καὶ ἐλάλησαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως.
vulg: responditque altera mulier non est ita sed filius tuus mortuus est meus autem vivit e contrario illa dicebat mentiris filius quippe meus vivit et filius tuus mortuus est atque in hunc modum contendebant coram rege
clem: Responditque altera mulier: Non est ita ut dicis, sed filius tuus mortuus est, meus autem vivit. E contrario illa dicebat: Mentiris: filius quippe meus vivit, et filius tuus mortuus est. Atque in hunc modum contendebant coram rege.
kjv: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ זֹאת אֹמֶרֶת זֶה־בְּנִי הַחַי וּבְנֵךְ הַמֵּת וְזֹאת אֹמֶרֶת לֹא כִי בְּנֵךְ הַמֵּת וּבְנִי הֶחָי ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς αὐταῖς Σὺ λέυεις Οὖτος ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ζῶν, καὶ ὁ υίός ταύτης ὁ τεθνηκώς· καὶ σὺ λέγεις Οὐχί, ἀλλὰ ὁ υἰός μου ὁ ζῶν, καὶ ὁ υἱός σου ὁτευνηκώς.
vulg: tunc rex ait haec dicit filius meus vivit et filius tuus mortuus est et ista respondit non sed filius tuus mortuus est et filius meus vivit
clem: Tunc rex ait: Hæc dicit: Filius meus vivit, et filius tuus mortuus est: et ista respondit: Non, sed filius tuus mortuus est, meus autem vivit.
kjv: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ קְחוּ לִי־חָרֶב וַיָּבִאוּ הַחֶרֶב לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς Λάβετε μάχαιραν· καὶ προσήνεεγκαν τὴν μάχαιραν ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως.
vulg: dixit ergo rex adferte mihi gladium cumque adtulissent gladium coram rege
clem: Dixit ergo rex: Afferte mihi gladium. Cumque attulissent gladium coram rege,
kjv: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ גִּזְרוּ אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד הַחַי לִשְׁנָיִם וּתְנוּ אֶת־הַחֲצִי לְאַחַת וְאֶת־הַחֲצִי לְאֶחָת ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς Διέλετε τὸ παιδίον τὸ θηλάζον τὸ ζῶν εἰς δύο, καὶ δότε τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτοῦ ταύτῃ καὶ τὸ ἤμισυ αὐτοῦ ταύτῃ.
vulg: dividite inquit infantem vivum in duas partes et date dimidiam partem uni et dimidiam partem alteri
clem: Dividite, inquit, infantem vivum in duas partes, et date dimidiam partem uni, et dimidiam partem alteri.
kjv: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

wlc: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר־בְּנָהּ הַחַי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־נִכְמְרוּ רַחֲמֶיהָ עַל־בְּנָהּ וַתֹּאמֶר בִּי אֲדֹנִי תְּנוּ־לָהּ אֶת־הַיָּלוּד הַחַי וְהָמֵת אַל־תְּמִיתֻהוּ וְזֹאת אֹמֶרֶת גַּם־לִי גַם־לָךְ לֹא יִהְיֶה גְּזֹרוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπεεκρίθη ἡ γυνὴ ἦς ἦν ὁ υίὸς ὁ ζῶν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα, ὄτι ἐταράχθη ἡ μήτρα αὐτῆς ἐπὶ τῷ υἱῷ αὐτῆς, καὶ εἶπεν ἐν ἐμοί, κύριε, δότε αὐτῇ τὸ παιδιον καὶ θανάτῳ μὴ θανταώσητε αὐτόν· καὶ αὔτη εἦπεν Μήτε ἑμοὶ μήτε αὐτῇ ἔστω· διέλετε.
vulg: dixit autem mulier cuius filius erat vivus ad regem commota sunt quippe viscera eius super filio suo obsecro domine date illi infantem vivum et nolite interficere eum contra illa dicebat nec mihi nec tibi sit dividatur
clem: Dixit autem mulier, cujus filius erat vivus, ad regem (commota sunt quippe viscera ejus super filio suo): Obsecro, domine, date illi infantem vivum, et nolite interficere eum. E contrario illa dicebat: Nec mihi nec tibi sit, sed dividatur.
kjv: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.

wlc: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר תְּנוּ־לָהּ אֶת־הַיָּלוּד הַחַי וְהָמֵת לֹא תְמִיתֻהוּ הִיא אִמּוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη ὁπεκρίθη ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ εἶπεν Δότε τὸ παιδίον τῇ εἰπούςῃ Δότε αὐτῇ αὐτὸ καὶ θανάτῳ μὴ θανταώσητε αὐτόν· αὐτὴ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: respondens rex ait date huic infantem vivum et non occidatur haec est mater eius
clem: Respondit rex, et ait: Date huic infantem vivum, et non occidatur: hæc est enim mater ejus.
kjv: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.

wlc: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּט אֲשֶׁר שָׁפַט הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּרְאוּ מִפְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי רָאוּ כִּי־חָכְמַת אֱלֹהִים בְּקִרְבּוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἤκουσαν πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ τὸ κρίμα τοῦτο ὃ ἔκρινεν ὁ βασιλεύς · καὶ ἐφοβήρησαν ἀπο προσώπου τοῦ βασιλέως, ὄτι εἶδον ὄτι φρόνησις θεοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ τοῦ ποιεῖν δικαίωα.
vulg: audivit itaque omnis Israhel iudicium quod iudicasset rex et timuerunt regem videntes sapientiam Dei esse in eo ad faciendum iudicium
clem: Audivit itaque omnis Israël judicium quod judicasset rex, et timuerunt regem, videntes sapientiam Dei esse in eo ad faciendum judicium.
kjv: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.

wlc: וַיְהִי הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃ ס
lxx: Καὶ ἦν ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμῶν βασιλεύων ἐπὶ Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: erat autem rex Salomon regnans super omnem Israhel
clem: Erat autem rex Salomon regnans super omnem Israël:
kjv: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה הַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶן־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ οὖτοι ἄρχοντες οἵ ἦσαν αὐτοῦ· Ἀζαρεὶ υἱὸς Σαδώκ,
vulg: et hii principes quos habebat Azarias filius Sadoc sacerdos
clem: et hi principes quos habebat: Azarias filius Sadoc sacerdotis:
kjv: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,

wlc: אֱלִיחֹרֶף וַאֲחִיָּה בְּנֵי שִׁישָׁא סֹפְרִים יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד הַמַּזְכִּיר ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἐλιὰφ καὶ Ἀχειὰ υἱὸς Σαβὰ γραμματεῖς, καὶ Ἰωσαφὰθ υἱὸς Ἀχειλιαδ ὑπομιμνήσκων,
vulg: Helioreph et Ahia filii Sesa scribae Iosaphat filius Ahilud a commentariis
clem: Elihoreph et Ahia filii Sisa scribæ: Josaphat filius Ahilud a commentariis:
kjv: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.

wlc: וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע עַל־הַצָּבָא וְצָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ Σαδοὺχ καὶ Ἀβιαθὰρ ἱερεῖς,
vulg: Banaias filius Ioiadae super exercitum Sadoc autem et Abiathar sacerdotes
clem: Banaias filius Jojadæ super exercitum: Sadoc autem et Abiathar sacerdotes:
kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

wlc: וַעֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶן־נָתָן עַל־הַנִּצָּבִים וְזָבוּד בֶּן־נָתָן כֹּהֵן רֵעֶה הַמֶּלֶךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ Ὀρνειὰ υἱὸς Ναθὰν ἐπὶ τῶν καθεσταμένων, καὶ Ζαβοὺθ υἱὸς ναθὰν ἑταῖρος τοῦ βασιλέως,
vulg: Azarias filius Nathan super eos qui adsistebant regi Zabud filius Nathan sacerdos amicus regis
clem: Azarias filius Nathan super eos qui assistebant regi: Zabud filius Nathan sacerdos, amicus regis:
kjv: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king's friend:

wlc: וַאֲחִישָׁר עַל־הַבָּיִת וַאֲדֹנִירָם בֶּן־עַבְדָּא עַל־הַמַּס ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ Ἀχεὶ ἦν οἰκονόμος, καὶ ἐλιὰκ ὁ οἰκονόμος, καὶ Ἐλιὰβ υἱὸς Σὰφ ἐπὶ τῆς πατριᾶς, καὶ Ἀδωνειρὰμ υἱὸς Ἐφρὰ ἐπὶ τῶν φόρων.
vulg: et Ahisar praepositus domus et Adoniram filius Abda super tributa
clem: et Ahisar præpositus domus: et Adoniram filius Abda super tributa.
kjv: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.

wlc: וְלִשְׁלֹמֹה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר נִצָּבִים עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִלְכְּלוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ חֹדֶשׁ בַּשָּׁנָה יִהְיֶה עַל־אֶחָד לְכַלְכֵּל ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ τῷ Σαλωμὲν δώδεκα καθεσταμένοι ἐπὶ πάντα Ἰσραήλ, χορηγεῖν τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ τᾦ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ· μῆνα ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ ἐγίνετο ἐπὶ τὸν ἕνα χορηγεῖν.
vulg: habebat autem Salomon duodecim praefectos super omnem Israhel qui praebebant annonam regi et domui eius per singulos enim menses in anno singuli necessaria ministrabant
clem: Habebat autem Salomon duodecim præfectos super omnem Israël, qui præbebant annonam regi et domui ejus: per singulos enim menses in anno, singuli necessaria ministrabant.
kjv: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹתָם בֶּן־חוּר בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν· Βαιὼρ ἐν ὄρει Ἐφράιμ, εἷς·
vulg: et haec nomina eorum Benhur in monte Ephraim
clem: Et hæc nomina eorum: Benhur in monte Ephraim.
kjv: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:

wlc: בֶּן־דֶּקֶר בְּמָקַץ וּבְשַׁעַלְבִים וּבֵית שָׁמֶשׁ וְאֵילוֹן בֵּית חָנָן ׃ ס
lxx: υἱὸς Ῥῆχας ἐν Μαχεμὰς καὶ Βηθαλαμεὶ καὶ βαιθςάμυς καὶ Ἐλμ ἕως Βαιθλαμάν, εἷς·
vulg: Bendecar in Macces et in Salebbim et in Bethsemes et Helon Bethanan
clem: Bendecar in Macces, et in Salebim, et in Bethsames, et in Elon, et in Bethanan.
kjv: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan:

wlc: בֶּן־חֶסֶד בָּאֲרֻבּוֹת לוֹ שֹׂכֹה וְכָל־אֶרֶץ חֵפֶר ׃ ס
lxx: υἱὸς Ἕσωθ, Βηρνεμαλουσαμηνχὰ καὶ ‘Ρησφαραχεὶν
vulg: Benesed in Araboth ipsius erat Soccho et omnis terra Epher
clem: Benhesed in Aruboth: ipsius erat Socho, et omnis terra Epher.
kjv: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:

wlc: בֶּן־אֲבִינָדָב כָּל־נָפַת דֹּאר טָפַת בַּת־שְׁלֹמֹה הָיְתָה לּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה ׃ ס
lxx: ἀνὰ Δὰν καὶ ἀνὰ Φαθεί, ἀνὴρ Ταβληθεί, θυγάτηρ Σαλωμὼν ἦν αὐτῷ εἰς γυναῖκα, εἷς·
vulg: Benabinadab cuius omnis Nepthad Dor Tapheth filiam Salomonis habebat uxorem
clem: Benabinadab, cujus omnis Nephath Dor: Tapheth filiam Salomonis habebat uxorem.
kjv: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

wlc: בַּעֲנָא בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד תַּעְנַךְ וּמְגִדּוֹ וְכָל־בֵּית שְׁאָן אֲשֶׁר אֵצֶל צָרְתַנָה מִתַּחַת לְיִזְרְעֶאל מִבֵּית שְׁאָן עַד אָבֵל מְחוֹלָה עַד מֵעֵבֶר לְיָקְמֳעָם ׃ ס
lxx: Βακχὰ υἱὸς Ἀχειμάχ, πολαμὰχ καὶ Μεκεδώ, καὶ πᾶς ὁ οἶκος Δὰν ὁ παρὰ Σεσαθὰν ὑποκάτω τοῦ Ἐσρᾶε, καὶ ἐκ Βαισαφοὺτ Ἐβελμαωλὰ ἕως Μαέβερ Λουκάμ, εἷς·
vulg: Bana filius Ahilud regebat Thanac et Mageddo et universam Bethsan quae est iuxta Sarthana subter Hiezrahel a Bethsan usque Abelmeula e regione Iecmaan
clem: Bana filius Ahilud regebat Thanac et Mageddo, et universam Bethsan, quæ est juxta Sarthana subter Jezrahel, a Bethsan usque Abelmehula e regione Jecmaan.
kjv: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Bethshean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Bethshean to Abelmeholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:

wlc: בֶּן־גֶּבֶר בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד לוֹ חַוֹּת יָאִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּלְעָד לוֹ חֶבֶל אַרְגֹּב אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּשָׁן שִׁשִּׁים עָרִים גְּדֹלוֹת חוֹמָה וּבְרִיחַ נְחֹשֶׁת ׃ ס
lxx: υἱὸς Γάβερ Ἐρεμὰθ Γαλαάθ, τούτῳ σχοίνισμα Ἐρεταβὰμ ἐν τῇ Βασάν, ἑξήκοντα πόλεις μεγάλαι τειχήρεις καὶ μοχλοὶ χαλκοῖ, εἷς·
vulg: Bengaber in Ramoth Galaad habebat Avothiair filii Manasse in Galaad ipse praeerat in omni regione Argob quae est in Basan sexaginta civitatibus magnis atque muratis quae habebant seras aereas
clem: Bengaber in Ramoth Galaad: habebat Avothjair filii Manasse in Galaad: ipse præerat in omni regione Argob, quæ est in Basan, sexaginta civitatibus magnis atque muratis quæ habebant seras æreas.
kjv: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:

wlc: אֲחִינָדָב בֶּן־עִדֹּא מַחֲנָיְמָה ׃
lxx: Ἀχειναὰβ υἱὸς Ἀχέλ, Μααναιεῖον·
vulg: Ahinadab filius Addo praeerat in Manaim
clem: Ahinadab filius Addo præerat in Manaim.
kjv: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:

wlc: אֲחִימַעַץ בְּנַפְתָּלִי גַּם־הוּא לָקַח אֶת־בָּשְׂמַת בַּת־שְׁלֹמֹה לְאִשָּׁה ׃
lxx: Ἀχειμάας ἐν Νεφθαλεί, καὶ οὗτος ἔλαβεν τὴν Βασεμμὰθ θυγατέρα Σαλωμών, εἷς·
vulg: Ahimaas in Nepthali sed et ipse habebat Basmath filiam Salomonis in coniugio
clem: Achimaas in Nephthali: sed et ipse habebat Basemath filiam Salomonis in conjugio.
kjv: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

wlc: בַּעֲנָא בֶּן־חוּשָׁי בְּאָשֵׁר וּבְעָלוֹת ׃ ס
lxx: Βαανὰ νἱὸς Χουσεὶ ἐν τῇ Μααλά, εἷς·
vulg: Baana filius Usi in Aser et in Balod
clem: Baana filius Husi in Aser, et in Baloth.
kjv: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:

wlc: יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־פָּרוּחַ בְּיִשָׂשכָר ׃ ס
lxx: υἱὸς Ἠλὰ ἐν τῷ Βενιαμείν·
vulg: Iosaphat filius Pharue in Isachar
clem: Josaphat filius Pharue in Issachar.
kjv: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:

wlc: שִׁמְעִי בֶן־אֵלָא בְּבִנְיָמִן ׃ ס
lxx: υἱὸς Ἀδαὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ Γὰδ τῇ Σηὼν βασιλέως τοῦ Ἑσεβὼν καὶ Ὢγ βασιλέως τοῦ Βασάμν· καὶ νασὲφ εἷς ἐν γῇ Ἰούδα·
vulg: Semei filius Hela in Beniamin
clem: Semei filius Ela in Benjamin.
kjv: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:

wlc: גֶּבֶר בֶּן־אֻרִי בְּאֶרֶץ גִּלְעָד אֶרֶץ סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וְעֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וּנְצִיב אֶחָד אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: Ἰωσαφὰτ υἱὸς φουασοὺδ ἐν Ἰσσαχάρ.
vulg: Gaber filius Uri in terra Galaad in terra Seon regis Amorrei et Og regis Basan super omnia quae erant in illa terra
clem: Gaber filius Uri in terra Galaad, in terra Sehon regis Amorrhæi et Og regis Basan, super omnia quæ erant in illa terra.
kjv: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.

wlc: יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל רַבִּים כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַיָּם לָרֹב אֹכְלִים וְשֹׁתִים וּשְׂמֵחִים ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐχορήγουν οἱ καθεσταμένοι οἵτως τῷ βασιλεῖ Σαλωμών, καὶ πάντα διαγγέλματα ἐπὶ τὴν τράπεζαν τοῦ βασιλέως, ἔκαστος μῆνα αὐτοῦ· οὐ παραλλάσσουσιν λόγον·
vulg: Iuda et Israhel innumerabiles sicut harena maris in multitudine comedentes et bibentes atque laetantes
clem: Juda et Israël innumerabiles, sicut arena maris in multitudine: comedentes, et bibentes, atque lætantes.
kjv: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.

lxx: καὶ τὰς κριθὰς καὶ τὸ ἄχυρον τοῖς ἵπποις καὶ τοῖς ἅρμασιν ᾖρον εἰς τὸν τόπον οὖ ἄν ᾖ ὁ βασιλεύς, ἔκαστος κατὰ τὴν σύνταξιν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: Salomon autem erat in dicione sua habens omnia regna sicut a flumine terrae Philisthim usque ad terminum Aegypti offerentium sibi munera et servientium ei cunctis diebus vitae eius
clem: Salomon autem erat in ditione sua, habens omnia regna a flumine terræ Philisthiim usque ad terminum Ægypti: offerentium sibi munera, et servientium ei cunctis diebus vitæ ejus.
kjv: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.

lxx: καὶ ταπυτα τὰ δέοντα τῷ Σαλωμὼν ἐν ἐν ἠμέρᾳ μιᾷ· τριάκοντα κόροι σεμιδάλεως καὶ ἑξήκοντα κόροι ἀλεύρου κεκοπανισμένου,
vulg: erat autem cibus Salomonis per dies singulos triginta chori similae et sexaginta chori farinae
clem: Erat autem cibus Salomonis per dies singulos triginta cori similæ, et sexaginta cori farinæ,
kjv: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,

lxx: καὶ δέκα μόσχοι έκλεκτοὶ καὶ εἴκοσι βόες νομάδες καὶ ἑκατὸν πρόβατα, ἐκτὸς ἐλάφων καὶ δορκόδων δορκάδων καὶ ὀρνίθων ἐκλεκτῶν, σιτευτά.
vulg: decem boves pingues et viginti boves pascuales et centum arietes excepta venatione cervorum caprearum atque bubalorum et avium altilium
clem: decem boves pingues, et viginti boves pascuales, et centum arietes, excepta venatione cervorum, caprearum, atque bubalorum, et avium altilium.
kjv: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.

lxx: ὅτι ἦν ἄρχων πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ, καὶ ἦν αὐτῷ εἰρήνη ἐκ πάντων τῶν μερῶν κυκλόξεν.
vulg: ipse enim obtinebat omnem regionem quae erat trans flumen quasi a Thapsa usque Gazam et cunctos reges illarum regionum et habebat pacem ex omni parte in circuitu
clem: Ipse enim obtinebat omnem regionem quæ erat trans flumen, a Thaphsa usque ad Gazan, et cunctos reges illarum regionum: et habebat pacem ex omni parte in circuitu.
kjv: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.

lxx: καὶ ἔδωκεν Κύριος φρόνησιν τῷ Σαλωμὼν καὶ σοφίαν πολλὴν σφόδρα καὶ χύμα καρδίας ὡς ἡ ἄμμος ἠ παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν.
vulg: habitabatque Iudas et Israhel absque timore ullo unusquisque sub vite sua et sub ficu sua a Dan usque Bersabee cunctis diebus Salomonis
clem: Habitabatque Juda et Israël absque timore ullo, unusquisque sub vite sua et sub ficu sua, a Dan usque Bersabee, cunctis diebus Salomonis.
kjv: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.

lxx: καὶ ἐπληθύνθη Σαλωμὼν σφόδρα ὑπέρ τὴν φρόησιν πάντων ἀρχαίων ἀνθρώπων καὶ ὑπὲρ πάντας φρονίμους Αἰγύπτου.
vulg: et habebat Salomon quadraginta milia praesepia equorum currulium et duodecim milia equestrium
clem: Et habebat Salomon quadraginta millia præsepia equorum currilium, et duodecim millia equestrium.
kjv: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

lxx: καὶ ἐσοφίσατο ὑπὲρ πάντας τοῦς ἀνθρώπους, καὶ ἐεσοξίσατο ὑπὲρ Γαιξὰν τὸν Ζαρείτην καὶ τὸν Αἰνὰν καὶ τὸν Χαλκὰδ καὶ Δαραλά, υἱὸς Μάλ.
vulg: nutriebantque eos supradicti regis praefecti sed et necessaria mensae regis Salomonis cum ingenti cura praebebant in tempore suo
clem: Nutriebantque eos supradicti regis præfecti: sed et necessaria mensæ regis Salomonis cum ingenti cura præbebant in tempore suo.
kjv: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.

lxx: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Σαλωμὼν τρισχιλίας παραβολάς, καὶ ἦσαν ῲδαὶ αὐτοῦ πεντακισχίλιαι.
vulg: hordeum quoque et paleas equorum et iumentorum deferebant in locum ubi erat rex iuxta constitutum sibi
clem: Hordeum quoque, et paleas equorum et jumentorum, deferebant in locum ubi erat rex, juxta constitutum sibi.
kjv: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.

lxx: καὶ ἐλάλησεν ὑπὲρ τῶν ξύλων ἀπὸ τὴς κ΄δρου τῆς ἐν τῷ Λιβάνῳ καὶ ἔως τῆς ὑσσώπου τῆς ἐκπορευομένηνης διὰ τοῦ τοίχου, καὶ ἐλάλησεν περὶ τῶν κτηνῶν καὶ περὶ τῶν πετεινῶν καὶ περὶ τῶν ἐρπετῶν καὶ περὶ τῶν ἰχθύων.
vulg: dedit quoque Deus sapientiam Salomoni et prudentiam multam nimis et latitudinem cordis quasi harenam quae est in litore maris
clem: Dedit quoque Deus sapientiam Salomoni, et prudentiam multam nimis, et latitudinem cordis quasi arenam quæ est in littore maris.
kjv: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.

lxx: καὶ παρεγίνοντο πάντες οἱ λαοὶ ἀκοῦσαι τῆς σοφίας Σαλωμών, καὶ παρὰ πάντων τῶν βασιλέων τῆς γῆς ὅσοι ἤκουον τῆς σοφίας αὐτοῦ.
vulg: et praecedebat sapientia Salomonis sapientiam omnium Orientalium et Aegyptiorum
clem: Et præcedebat sapientia Salomonis sapientiam omnium Orientalium et Ægyptiorum,
kjv: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.

lxx: Καὶ ἔλαβεν Σαλωμὼν τὴν θυγατέρα φαραὼ ἑαυτῷ εἰς γυναῖκα, καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτὴν εἰς τὴν πόλιν Δαυεὶδ ἕως συντελέσαι αὐτὸν τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου καὶ τὸν οἶκον ἑαυτοῦ καὶ τὸ τειχος Ἰερουσαλήμ.
vulg: et erat sapientior cunctis hominibus sapientior Aethan Ezraita et Heman et Chalcal et Dorda filiis Maol et erat nominatus in universis gentibus per circuitum
clem: et erat sapientior cunctis hominibus: sapientior Ethan Ezrahita, et Heman, et Chalcol, et Dorda filiis Mahol: et erat nominatus in universis gentibus per circuitum.
kjv: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.

lxx: ὅτε ἀνεβη φαραὼ βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου, καὶ προκατελάβετο τὴν Γάζερ καὶ ἐνεπύρισεν αὐτὴν καὶ τὸν Χανανείτην τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν Μεργάβ· καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὰς φαραὼ ἀποστολὰς θυγατρὶ αὐτοῦ γυναικὶ Σαλωμών·
vulg: locutus est quoque Salomon tria milia parabolas et fuerunt carmina eius quinque et mille
clem: Locutus est quoque Salomon tria millia parabolas: et fuerunt carmina ejus quinque et mille.
kjv: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.

lxx: καὶ Σαλωμὼν ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν Γάζερ. V
vulg: et disputavit super lignis a cedro quae est in Libano usque ad hysopum quae egreditur de pariete et disseruit de iumentis et volucribus et reptilibus et piscibus
clem: Et disputavit super lignis a cedro quæ est in Libano, usque ad hyssopum quæ egreditur de pariete: et disseruit de jumentis, et volucribus, et reptilibus, et piscibus.
kjv: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.

vulg: et veniebant de cunctis populis ad audiendam sapientiam Salomonis et ab universis regibus terrae qui audiebant sapientiam eius
clem: Et veniebant de cunctis populis ad audiendam sapientiam Salomonis, et ab universis regibus terræ qui audiebant sapientiam ejus.
kjv: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.

wlc: וּשְׁלֹמֹה הָיָה מוֹשֵׁל בְּכָל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת מִן־הַנָּהָר אֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְעַד גְּבוּל מִצְרָיִם מַגִּשִׁים מִנְחָה וְעֹבְדִים אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה כָּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו ׃ פ
lxx: Vχρίσαι τὸν Σαλωμὼν ἀντὶ Δαυεὶδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἀγαπῶν ἦν Χειρὰμ τὸν Δαυεὶδ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας.
vulg: misit quoque Hiram rex Tyri servos suos ad Salomonem audivit enim quod ipsum unxissent regem pro patre eius quia amicus fuerat Hiram David omni tempore
clem: Misit quoque Hiram rex Tyri servos suos ad Salomonem: audivit enim quod ipsum unxissent regem pro patre ejus: quia amicus fuerat Hiram David omni tempore.
kjv: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

wlc: וַיְהִי לֶחֶם־שְׁלֹמֹה לְיוֹם אֶחָד שְׁלֹשִׁים כֹּר סֹלֶת וְשִׁשִּׁים כֹּר קָמַח ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Σαλωμὼν πρὸς Χειρὰμ λέγων
vulg: misit autem et Salomon ad Hiram dicens
clem: Misit autem Salomon ad Hiram, dicens:
kjv: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

wlc: עֲשָׂרָה בָקָר בְּרִאִים וְעֶשְׂרִים בָּקָר רְעִי וּמֵאָה צֹאן לְבַד מֵאַיָּל וּצְבִי וְיַחְמוּר וּבַרְבֻּרִים אֲבוּסִים ׃
lxx: Σὺ οἶδας Δαυεὶδ τὸν πατέρα μου ὅτι οὐκ ἐδύνατο οἰκοδομῆσαι οἶκον τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου θεοῦ μου ἀπὸ τροςώπου τῶν πολέμων τῶν κυκλωςάντων αὐτόν, ἕως τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτοὺς ὑπὸ τὰ ἴχνη τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: tu scis voluntatem David patris mei et quia non potuerit aedificare domum nomini Domini Dei sui propter bella inminentia per circuitum donec daret Dominus eos sub vestigio pedum eius
clem: Tu scis voluntatem David patris mei, et quia non potuerit ædificare domum nomini Domini Dei sui propter bella imminentia per circuitum, donec daret Dominus eos sub vestigio pedum ejus.
kjv: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the Lord his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the Lord put them under the soles of his feet.

wlc: כִּי־הוּא רֹדֶה בְּכָל־עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר מִתִּפְסַח וְעַד־עַזָּה בְּכָל־מַלְכֵי עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וְשָׁלוֹם הָיָה לוֹ מִכָּל־עֲבָרָיו מִסָּבִיב ׃
lxx: καὶ νῦν ἀνέπαυσε Κύριος ὁ θεός μου ἐμοὶ κυκλόθεν· οὐκ ἔστιν ἐπίβουλος καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἁμάρτημα πονηρόν.
vulg: nunc autem requiem dedit Deus meus mihi per circuitum non est Satan neque occursus malus
clem: Nunc autem requiem dedit Dominus Deus meus mihi per circuitum, et non est satan, neque occursus malus.
kjv: But now the Lord my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.

wlc: וַיֵּשֶׁב יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לָבֶטַח אִישׁ תַּחַת גַּפְנוֹ וְתַחַת תְּאֵנָתוֹ מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שָׁבַע כֹּל יְמֵי שְׁלֹמֹה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ λέγω Οἰκοδομήσω οἶκον τῷ ὀνόματι Κυπίου θεοῦ μου, καθὼς ἐλάλησεν Κύριος ὁ θεὸς προς Δαυεὶδ τὸν πατέρα μου λέγων Ὁ υἱός σου ὃν δώσω ἀντὶ σοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον σου, οὖτος οἰκοδομήσει τὸν οἶκον τῷ ὀνόματί μου.
vulg: quam ob rem cogito aedificare templum nomini Domini Dei mei sicut locutus est Dominus David patri meo dicens filius tuus quem dabo pro te super solium tuum ipse aedificabit domum nomini meo
clem: Quam ob rem cogito ædificare templum nomini Domini Dei mei, sicut locutus est Dominus David patri meo, dicens: Filius tuus, quem dabo pro te super solium tuum, ipse ædificabit domum nomini meo.
kjv: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the Lord my God, as the Lord spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.

wlc: וַיְהִי לִשְׁלֹמֹה אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף אֻרְוֹת סוּסִים לְמֶרְכָּבוֹ וּשְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים ׃
lxx: καὶ νῦν ἔντειλαι καὶ κοψάτωςάν μοι ξύλα ἐκ τοῦ Λιβάνου· καὶ ἰδοὺ οἱ δοῦλοί μου μετὰ τῶν δούλων σου, δουλείας σου δωσω σοι κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐὰν εἴπῃς, ὅτι σὺ οἶδας ὄτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἰδίως ξύλα κόπτειν καθὼς οἱ Σιδώνιοι.
vulg: praecipe igitur ut praecidant mihi cedros de Libano et servi mei sint cum servis tuis mercedem autem servorum tuorum dabo tibi quamcumque praeceperis scis enim quoniam non est in populo meo vir qui noverit ligna caedere sicut Sidonii
clem: Præcipe igitur ut præcidant mihi servi tui cedros de Libano, et servi mei sint cum servis tuis: mercedem autem servorum tuorum dabo tibi quamcumque petieris: scis enim quomodo non est in populo meo vir qui noverit ligna cædere sicut Sidonii.
kjv: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.

wlc: וְכִלְכְּלוּ הַנִּצָּבִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וְאֵת כָּל־הַקָּרֵב אֶל־שֻׁלְחַן הַמֶּלֶךְ־שְׁלֹמֹה אִישׁ חָדְשׁוֹ לֹא יְעַדְּרוּ דָּבָר ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐγεωήθη καθὼς ἤκουσεν Χειρὰμ τῶν λόγων Σαλωμών, ἐχάρη σφόδρα καὶ εἶπεν Εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς σήμερον ὃς ἔδωκεν τῷ Δαυεὶδ υἱὸν φρόνιμον ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν τὸν πολὺν τοῦτον.
vulg: cum ergo audisset Hiram verba Salomonis laetatus est valde et ait benedictus Dominus hodie qui dedit David filium sapientissimum super populum hunc plurimum
clem: Cum ergo audisset Hiram verba Salomonis, lætatus est valde, et ait: Benedictus Dominus Deus hodie, qui dedit David filium sapientissimum super populum hunc plurimum.
kjv: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the Lord this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.

wlc: וְהַשְּׂעֹרִים וְהַתֶּבֶן לַסּוּסִים וְלָרָכֶשׁ יָבִאוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה־שָּׁם אִישׁ כְּמִשְׁפָּטוֹ ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς Σαλωμὼν λέγων Ἀκήκοα περὶ πάντων ὦν ἀπέσταλκας πρὸς μέ· ἐγὼ ποιήσω πᾶν θέλγμά σου, ξύλα κέδρινα καὶ πεύκινα.
vulg: et misit Hiram ad Salomonem dicens audivi quaecumque mandasti mihi ego faciam omnem voluntatem tuam in lignis cedrinis et abiegnis
clem: Et misit Hiram ad Salomonem, dicens: Audivi quæcumque mandasti mihi: ego faciam omnem voluntatem tuam in lignis cedrinis et abiegnis.
kjv: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

wlc: וַיִּתֵּן אֱלֹהִים חָכְמָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה וּתְבוּנָה הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד וְרֹחַב לֵב כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל־שְׂפַת הַיָּם ׃
lxx: οἱ δοῦλοί μου καάξουστν αὐτὰ ἐκ τοῦ Λιβάνου εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, ἐγὼ θήσομαι αὐτὰ σχεδίας ἕως τοῦ τόπου οὖ ἐὰν ἀποστείλῃς πρὸς μέ, καὶ ἐκτινάξω αὐτὰ ἐκεῖ καὶ σὺ ἀρεῖς· καὶ ποιήσεις τὸ θέλημά μου τοῦ δοῦναι ἄρτους τῷ οἴκῳ μου.
vulg: servi mei deponent ea de Libano ad mare et ego conponam ea in ratibus in mari usque ad locum quem significaveris mihi et adplicabo ea ibi et tu tolles ea praebebisque necessaria mihi ut detur cibus domui meae
clem: Servi mei deponent ea de Libano ad mare, et ego componam ea in ratibus in mari usque ad locum quem significaveris mihi: et applicabo ea ibi, et tu tolles ea: præbebisque necessaria mihi, ut detur cibus domui meæ.
kjv: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.

wlc: וַתֵּרֶב חָכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה מֵחָכְמַת כָּל־בְּנֵי־קֶדֶם וּמִכֹּל חָכְמַת מִצְרָיִם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἦν Χειρὰμ διδοὺς τῷ Σαλωμὼν κέδρους καὶ πᾶν θέλημα αὐτοῦ.
vulg: itaque Hiram dabat Salomoni ligna cedrina et ligna abiegna iuxta omnem voluntatem eius
clem: Itaque Hiram dabat Salomoni ligna cedrina, et ligna abiegna, juxta omnem voluntatem ejus.
kjv: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.

wlc: וַיֶּחְכַּם מִכָּל־הָאָדָם מֵאֵיתָן הָאֶזְרָחִי וְהֵימָן וְכַלְכֹּל וְדַרְדַּע בְּנֵי מָחוֹל וַיְהִי־שְׁמוֹ בְכָל־הַגּוֹיִם סָבִיב ׃
lxx: καὶ Σαλωμὼν ἔδωκεν τῷ Χειρὰμ εἴκοσι χιλιάδας κόρους πυροῦ καὶ μαχεὶρ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοὺ καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδας βαὶθ ελαίου κεκομμένου· κατὰ τοῦτο εκδίδου Σαλωμὼν τῷ Χειρὰμ κατ’ ἐνιαυτόν.
vulg: Salomon autem praebebat Hiram viginti milia chororum tritici in cibum domui eius et viginti choros purissimi olei haec tribuebat Salomon Hiram per annos singulos
clem: Salomon autem præbebat Hiram coros tritici viginti millia in cibum domui ejus, et viginti coros purissimi olei: hæc tribuebat Salomon Hiram per singulos annos.
kjv: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.

wlc: וַיְדַבֵּר שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים מָשָׁל וַיְהִי שִׁירוֹ חֲמִשָּׁה וָאָלֶף ׃
lxx: καὶ Κύριος ἔδωκεν σοφίαν τῷ Σαλωμών, καθὼς ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ. καὶ ἦν εἰρήνη ἀνὰ μέσον Χειρὰμ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσοον Σαλωμών, καὶ διέθεντο διαθήκην ἀνὰν μέσον ἑαυτῶν.
vulg: dedit quoque Dominus sapientiam Salomoni sicut locutus est ei et erat pax inter Hiram et Salomonem et percusserunt foedus ambo
clem: Dedit quoque Dominus sapientiam Salomoni, sicut locutus est ei: et erat pax inter Hiram et Salomonem, et percusserunt ambo fœdus.
kjv: And the Lord gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.

wlc: וַיְדַבֵּר עַל־הָעֵצִים מִן־הָאֶרֶז אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן וְעַד הָאֵזוֹב אֲשֶׁר יֹצֵא בַּקִּיר וַיְדַבֵּר עַל־הַבְּהֵמָה וְעַל־הָעוֹף וְעַל־הָרֶמֶשׂ וְעַל־הַדָּגִים ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν ὁ βασιλεὺς φόρον καὶ ἐκ παντὸς Ἰσραήλ, καὶ ἦν ὁ φόρος τριάκοντα χιλιάδες αὐτδρῶν.
vulg: legitque rex Salomon operas de omni Israhel et erat indictio triginta milia virorum
clem: Elegitque rex Salomon operarios de omni Israël, et erat indictio triginta millia virorum.
kjv: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

wlc: וַיָּבֹאוּ מִכָּל־הָעַמִּים לִשְׁמֹעַ אֵת חָכְמַת שְׁלֹמֹה מֵאֵת כָּל־מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר שָׁמְעוּ אֶת־חָכְמָתוֹ ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν Λίβανον, δέκα χιλιάδες ἐν τῷ ηνί, ἀλλασσόμενοι· μῆνα ἦσαν ἐν τῷ Λιβάνῳ καὶ δύο μῆνας ἐν οἴκῳ αὐτῶν· καὶ Ἀδωνειρὰμ ἐπὶ τοῦ φόρου.
vulg: mittebatque eos in Libanum decem milia per menses singulos vicissim ita ut duobus mensibus essent in domibus suis et Adoniram erat super huiuscemodi indictione
clem: Mittebatque eos in Libanum, decem millia per menses singulos vicissim, ita ut duobus mensibus essent in domibus suis: et Adoniram erat super hujuscemodi indictione.
kjv: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.

wlc: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צוֹר אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי אֹתוֹ מָשְׁחוּ לְמֶלֶךְ תַּחַת אָבִיהוּ כִּי אֹהֵב הָיָה חִירָם לְדָוִד כָּל־הַיָּמִים ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἦν τῷ Σαλωμὼν ἑβδομήκοντα χιλιάδες αἴροντες ἄρσιν καὶ ὀγδοήκοντα χιλιάδες λατόμων ἐν τῷ ὄρει,
vulg: fuerunt itaque Salomoni septuaginta milia eorum qui onera portabant et octoginta milia latomorum in monte
clem: Fueruntque Salomoni septuaginta millia eorum qui onera portabant, et octoginta millia latomorum in monte,
kjv: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;

wlc: וַיִּשְׁלַח שְׁלֹמֹה אֶל־חִירָם לֵאמֹר ׃
lxx: χωρὶς ἀρχόντων τῶν καθεσταμένων ἐπὶ τῶν ἔργων τῶν Σαλωμών, τρεῖς χιλιάδες καὶ ἑξακόσιοι ἐπιστάται, οἱ ποιοῦντες τὰ ἔργα.
vulg: absque praepositis qui praeerant singulis operibus numero trium milium et trecentorum praecipientium populo et his qui faciebant opus
clem: absque præpositis qui præerant singulis operibus, numero trium millium et trecentorum, præcipientium populo et his qui faciebant opus.
kjv: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.

wlc: אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־דָּוִד אָבִי כִּי לֹא יָכֹל לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו מִפְּנֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲשֶׁר סְבָבֻהוּ עַד תֵּת־יְהוָה אֹתָם תַּחַת כַּפּוֹת רַגְלוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τοὺς λίθους καὶ τὰ ξύλα τρία ἔτη. Καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῷ τεσσεεερακοστῇ καὶ τετρακοσιοστῷ VI
vulg: praecepitque rex ut tollerent lapides grandes lapides pretiosos in fundamentum templi et quadrarent eos
clem: Præcepitque rex ut tollerent lapides grandes, lapides pretiosos in fundamentum templi, et quadrarent eos:
kjv: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.

wlc: וְעַתָּה הֵנִיחַ יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי לִי מִסָּבִיב אֵין שָׂטָן וְאֵין פֶּגַע רָע ׃
vulg: quos dolaverunt cementarii Salomonis et cementarii Hiram porro Biblii praeparaverunt ligna et lapides ad aedificandam domum
clem: quos dolaverunt cæmentarii Salomonis et cæmentarii Hiram: porro Giblii præparaverunt ligna et lapides ad ædificandam domum.
kjv: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.

wlc: וְהִנְנִי אֹמֵר לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִי לֵאמֹר בִּנְךָ אֲשֶׁר אֶתֵּן תַּחְתֶּיךָ עַל־כִּסְאֶךָ הוּא־יִבְנֶה הַבַּיִת לִשְׁמִי ׃

וְעַתָּה צַוֵּה וְיִכְרְתוּ־לִי אֲרָזִים מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן וַעֲבָדַי יִהְיוּ עִם־עֲבָדֶיךָ וּשְׂכַר עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶתֵּן לְךָ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמֵר כִּי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ כִּי אֵין בָּנוּ אִישׁ יֹדֵעַ לִכְרָת־עֵצִים כַּצִּדֹנִים ׃
וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ חִירָם אֶת־דִּבְרֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּשְׂמַח מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְדָוִד בֵּן חָכָם עַל־הָעָם הָרָב הַזֶּה ׃
וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר שָׁמַעְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַחְתָּ אֵלָי אֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־כָּל־חֶפְצְךָ בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וּבַעֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים ׃

עֲבָדַי יֹרִדוּ מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן יָמָּה וַאֲנִי אֲשִׂימֵם דֹּבְרוֹת בַּיָּם עַד־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־תִּשְׁלַח אֵלַי וְנִפַּצְתִּים שָׁם וְאַתָּה תִשָּׂא וְאַתָּה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֶת־חֶפְצִי לָתֵת לֶחֶם בֵּיתִי ׃
וַיְהִי חִירוֹם נֹתֵן לִשְׁלֹמֹה עֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וַעֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים כָּל־חֶפְצוֹ ׃
וּשְׁלֹמֹה נָתַן לְחִירָם עֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף כֹּר חִטִּים מַכֹּלֶת לְבֵיתוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים כֹּר שֶׁמֶן כָּתִית כֹּה־יִתֵּן שְׁלֹמֹה לְחִירָם שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה ׃ פ
וַיהוָה נָתַן חָכְמָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר־לוֹ וַיְהִי שָׁלֹם בֵּין חִירָם וּבֵין שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּכְרְתוּ בְרִית שְׁנֵיהֶם ׃
וַיַּעַל הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מַס מִכָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי הַמַּס שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף אִישׁ ׃
וַיִּשְׁלָחֵם לְבָנוֹנָה עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים בַּחֹדֶשׁ חֲלִיפוֹת חֹדֶשׁ יִהְיוּ בַלְּבָנוֹן שְׁנַיִם חֳדָשִׁים בְּבֵיתוֹ וַאֲדֹנִירָם עַל־הַמַּס ׃ ס
וַיְהִי לִשְׁלֹמֹה שִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף נֹשֵׂא סַבָּל וּשְׁמֹנִים אֶלֶף חֹצֵב בָּהָר ׃
לְבַד מִשָּׂרֵי הַנִּצָּבִים לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמְּלָאכָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת הָרֹדִים בָּעָם הָעֹשִׂים בַּמְּלָאכָה ׃
וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּסִּעוּ אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת לְיַסֵּד הַבָּיִת אַבְנֵי גָזִית ׃
וַיִּפְסְלוּ בֹּנֵי שְׁלֹמֹה וּבֹנֵי חִירוֹם וְהַגִּבְלִים וַיָּכִינוּ הָעֵצִים וְהָאֲבָנִים לִבְנוֹת הַבָּיִת ׃ פ

וַיְהִי בִשְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה לְצֵאת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ־מִצְרַיִם בַּשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִית בְּחֹדֶשׁ זִו הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי לִמְלֹךְ שְׁלֹמֹה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּבֶן הַבַּיִת לַיהוָה ׃
lxx: VIἔτει τῆς ἐξόδου υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐξ Αἰγύπτου, τῷ ἔτει τῷ τετάρτῳ ἐν μηνὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ βασιλεύοντος τοῦ βασιλέως Σαλωμὼν ἐπὶ Ἰσραήλ,
vulg: factum est igitur quadringentesimo et octogesimo anno egressionis filiorum Israhel de terra Aegypti in anno quarto mense zio ipse est mensis secundus regis Salomonis super Israhel aedificare coepit domum Domino
clem: Factum est ergo quadringentesimo et octogesimo anno egressionis filiorum Israël de terra Ægypti, in anno quarto, mense Zio (ipse est mensis secundus), regni Salomonis super Israël, ædificari cœpit domus Domino.
kjv: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the Lord.

wlc: וְהַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה לַיהוָה שִׁשִּׁים־אַמָּה אָרְכּוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים רָחְבּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ αἴρουσιν λίθους μεγάλους τιμίους εἰς τὸν θεμέλιον τοῦ οἴκου καὶ λίθους ἀπελεκήτους·
vulg: domus autem quam aedificabat rex Salomon Domino habebat sexaginta cubitos in longitudine et viginti cubitos in latitudine et triginta cubitos in altitudine
clem: Domus autem quam ædificabat rex Salomon Domino, habebat sexaginta cubitos in longitudine, et viginti cubitos in latitudine, et triginta cubitos in altitudine.
kjv: And the house which king Solomon built for the Lord, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.

wlc: וְהָאוּלָם עַל־פְּנֵי הֵיכַל הַבַּיִת עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה אָרְכּוֹ עַל־פְּנֵי רֹחַב הַבָּיִת עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה רָחְבּוֹ עַל־פְּנֵי הַבָּיִת ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπελέκησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Σαλωμὼν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Χειράμ, καὶ ἔβαλαν αὐτούς.
vulg: et porticus erat ante templum viginti cubitorum longitudinis iuxta mensuram latitudinis templi et habebat decem cubitos latitudinis ante faciem templi
clem: Et porticus erat ante templum viginti cubitorum longitudinis, juxta mensuram latitudinis templi: et habebat decem cubitos latitudinis ante faciem templi.
kjv: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.

wlc: וַיַּעַשׂ לַבָּיִת חַלּוֹנֵי שְׁקֻפִים אֲטֻמִים ׃
lxx: ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ τετάρτῳ ἐθεμελίωσεν τὸν οἷκον Κυρίου, ἐν μηνὶ Νεισῷ καὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ μηνί.
vulg: fecitque in templo fenestras obliquas
clem: Fecitque in templo fenestras obliquas.
kjv: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.

wlc: וַיִּבֶן עַל־קִיר הַבַּיִת יָצוֹעַ סָבִיב אֶת־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת סָבִיב לַהֵיכָל וְלַדְּבִיר וַיַּעַשׂ צְלָעוֹת סָבִיב ׃
lxx: ἐν ἑνδεκάτῳ ἐνιαυτῷ ἐν μηνὶ Βαάδ, οὗτος ὁ μὴν ὁ ὅγδοος, συνετελέσθη ὁ οἶκος εἰς πάντα λόγον αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς πᾶσαν διάταξιν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: et aedificavit super parietem templi tabulata per gyrum in parietibus domus per circuitum templi et oraculi et fecit latera in circuitu
clem: Et ædificavit super parietem templi tabulata per gyrum, in parietibus domus per circuitum templi et oraculi, et fecit latera in circuitu.
kjv: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:

wlc: הַיָּצוֹעַ הַתַּחְתֹּנָה חָמֵשׁ בָּאַמָּה רָחְבָּהּ וְהַתִּיכֹנָה שֵׁשׁ בָּאַמָּה רָחְבָּהּ וְהַשְּׁלִישִׁית שֶׁבַע בָּאַמָּה רָחְבָּהּ כִּי מִגְרָעוֹת נָתַן לַבַּיִת סָבִיב חוּצָה לְבִלְתִּי אֲחֹז בְּקִירוֹת־הַבָּיִת ׃
lxx: καὶ ὀ οἶκος ὅν ᾠκοδόμησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τῷ κυρίῳ, τεσσεράκοντα μῆκος αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἴκοσι ἐν πήχει πλάτος αὐτοῦ, καὶ πέντε καὶ εἲκοσι ἐν πήχει τὸ ὓψος αὐτοῦ.
vulg: tabulatum quod subter erat quinque cubitos habebat latitudinis et medium tabulatum sex cubitorum latitudinis et tertium tabulatum septem habens cubitos latitudinis trabes autem posuit in domo per circuitum forinsecus ut non hererent muris templi
clem: Tabulatum quod subter erat, quinque cubitos habebat latitudinis, et medium tabulatum sex cubitorum latitudinis, et tertium tabulatum septem habens cubitos latitudinis. Trabes autem posuit in domo per circuitum forinsecus, ut non hærerent muris templi.
kjv: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.

wlc: וְהַבַּיִת בְּהִבָּנֹתוֹ אֶבֶן־שְׁלֵמָה מַסָּע נִבְנָה וּמַקָּבוֹת וְהַגַּרְזֶן כָּל־כְּלִי בַרְזֶל לֹא־נִשְׁמַע בַּבַּיִת בְּהִבָּנֹתוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ τὸ αἰλὰμ κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ ναοῦ, εἲκοσι ἐν κήχει μῆκος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πλάτος τοῦ οἲκου κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ οἲκου.
vulg: domus autem cum aedificaretur lapidibus dedolatis atque perfectis aedificata est et malleus et securis et omne ferramentum non sunt audita in domo cum aedificaretur
clem: Domus autem cum ædificaretur, de lapidibus dolatis atque perfectis ædificata est: et malleus, et securis, et omne ferramentum non sunt audita in domo cum ædificaretur.
kjv: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.

wlc: פֶּתַח הַצֵּלָע הַתִּיכֹנָה אֶל־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית וּבְלוּלִּים יַעֲלוּ עַל־הַתִּיכֹנָה וּמִן־הַתִּיכֹנָה אֶל־הַשְּׁלִשִׁים ׃
lxx: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὸν οἶκον καὶ συνετέλεσεν αὐτόν.
vulg: ostium lateris medii in parte erat domus dexterae et per cocleam ascendebant in medium cenaculum et a medio in tertium
clem: Ostium lateris medii in parte erat domus dextræ: et per cochleam ascendebant in medium cœnaculum, et a medio in tertium.
kjv: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.

wlc: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הַבַּיִת וַיְכַלֵּהוּ וַיִּסְפֹּן אֶת־הַבַּיִת גֵּבִים וּשְׂדֵרֹת בָּאֲרָזִים ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐποίησεν τῷ οἲκῳ θυρίδας παρακυπτομένας καρυπτάς.
vulg: et aedificavit domum et consummavit eam texit quoque domum laquearibus cedrinis
clem: Et ædificavit domum, et consummavit eam: texit quoque domum laquearibus cedrinis.
kjv: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.

wlc: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הַיָּצוֹעַ עַל־כָּל־הַבַּיִת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתוֹ וַיֶּאֱחֹז אֶת־הַבַּיִת בַּעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἒδωκεν ἐπ᾿ αὐτὸν τοῖχον τοῦ οἲκου μέλαθρα κακλόθεν τῷ ναῷ καὶ τῷ δαβείρ.
vulg: et aedificavit tabulatum super omnem domum quinque cubitis altitudinis et operuit domum lignis cedrinis
clem: Et ædificavit tabulatum super omnem domum quinque cubitis altitudinis, et operuit domum lignis cedrinis.
kjv: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.

wlc: וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהוָה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה לֵאמֹר ׃
lxx: ἡ πλευρὰ ἡ ὑποκάτω πέντε πήχεων ἐν πήχει τὸ πλάτος αὐτῆς, καὶ τὸ μέσον ἒξ, καὶ ἡ τρίτη ἑπτὰ ἐν πήχει τὸ πλάτος αὐτῆς· ὃτι διάστημα ἒδωκεν τῷ οἲκῳ κυκλόθεν ἒξωθεν τοῦ οἲκου, ὃπως μὴ ἐπιλαμβάνωται τῶν τοίχων τοῦ οἲκου.
vulg: et factus est sermo Domini ad Salomonem dicens
clem: Et factus est sermo Domini ad Salomonem, dicens:
kjv: And the word of the Lord came to Solomon, saying,

wlc: הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּה בֹנֶה אִם־תֵּלֵךְ בְּחֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי תַּעֲשֶׂה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹתַי לָלֶכֶת בָּהֶם וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־דְּבָרִי אִתָּךְ אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל־דָּוִד אָבִיךָ ׃
lxx: καὶ ὁ οἶκος ἐν τῷ οἰκοδομεῖσθαι αὐτὸν λίθοις ἀκροτόμοις ἀργοῖς ᾠκοδομήθη· καὶ σφῦρα καὶ πέλεκθς καὶ πᾶν σκεῦος σιδηροῦν οὐκ ἠκούσθη ἐν τῷ οἲτῳ ἐν τῷ οἰκοδομεῖσθαι αὐτόν.
vulg: domus haec quam aedificas si ambulaveris in praeceptis meis et iudicia mea feceris et custodieris omnia mandata mea gradiens per ea firmabo sermonem meum tibi quem locutus sum ad David patrem tuum
clem: Domus hæc, quam ædificas, si ambulaveris in præceptis meis, et judicia mea feceris, et custodieris omnia mandata mea, gradiens per ea, firmabo sermonem meum tibi, quem locutus sum ad David patrem tuum:
kjv: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:

wlc: וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא אֶעֱזֹב אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ὁ πυλὼν τῆς πλευρᾶς τῆς ὑποκάτωθεν ὑπὸ τὴν ὠμίαν τοῦ οἲκου τὴν δεξιάν, καὶ ἑλικτὴ ἀνάβασις εἰς τὸ μέσον καὶ ἐκ τῆς μέσης ἐπὶ τὰ τριώοφα.
vulg: et habitabo in medio filiorum Israhel et non derelinquam populum meum Israhel
clem: et habitabo in medio filiorum Israël, et non derelinquam populum meum Israël.
kjv: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.

wlc: וַיִּבֶן שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַבַּיִת וַיְכַלֵּהוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὸν οἶκον καὶ συνετέλεσεν αὐτόν·
vulg: igitur aedificavit Salomon domum et consummavit eam
clem: Igitur ædificavit Salomon domum, et consummavit eam.
kjv: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

wlc: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת מִבַּיְתָה בְּצַלְעוֹת אֲרָזִים מִקַּרְקַע הַבַּיִת עַד־קִירוֹת הַסִּפֻּן צִפָּה עֵץ מִבָּיִת וַיְצַף אֶת־קַרְקַע הַבַּיִת בְּצַלְעוֹת בְּרוֹשִׁים ׃
lxx: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τοὺς ἐνδέσμους δι' ὅλου τοῦ οἴκου πέντε ἐν πήχει τὸ ὓψος αὐτοῦ, καὶ συνέσχεν τὸν σύνδεσμον ἐν ξύλοις κεδρίνοις.
vulg: et aedificavit parietes domus intrinsecus tabulatis cedrinis a pavimento domus usque ad summitatem parietum et usque ad laquearia operuit lignis intrinsecus et texit pavimentum domus tabulis abiegnis
clem: Et ædificavit parietes domus intrinsecus tabulatis cedrinis: a pavimento domus usque ad summitatem parietum, et usque ad laquearia, operuit lignis cedrinis intrinsecus: et texit pavimentum domus tabulis abiegnis.
kjv: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the ceiling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.

wlc: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה מִיַּרְכּוֹתֵי הַבַּיִת בְּצַלְעוֹת אֲרָזִים מִן־הַקַּרְקַע עַד־הַקִּירוֹת וַיִּבֶן לוֹ מִבַּיִת לִדְבִיר לְקֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים ׃
lxx: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τοὺς τοίχους τοῦ οἲκου διὰ ξύλων κεδρίνων ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐδάφους τοῦ οἲκου καὶ ἓως τῶν δοκῶν καὶ ἓως τῶν τοίχων· ἐκοιλοστάθμησεν συνεχόμενος ξύλοις ἒσωθεν, καὶ περιέσχεν τὸ ἒσω τοῦ οἲκου ἐν πλευραῖς πευκίναις.
vulg: aedificavitque viginti cubitorum ad posteriorem partem templi tabulata cedrina a pavimento usque ad superiora et fecit interiorem domum oraculi in sanctum sanctorum
clem: Ædificavitque viginti cubitorum ad posteriorem partem templi tabulata cedrina, a pavimento usque ad superiora: et fecit interiorem domum oraculi in Sanctum sanctorum.
kjv: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.

wlc: וְאַרְבָּעִים בָּאַמָּה הָיָה הַבָּיִת הוּא הַהֵיכָל לִפְנָי ׃
lxx: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τοὺς εἲκοσι πήχεις ἀπ᾿ ἂκρου τοῦ τοίχου, τὸ πλευρὸν τὸ ἓν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐδάφους ἓως τῶν δοκῶν· καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐκ τοῦ δαβεὶρ εἰς τὸ ἅγιον τῶν ἀγίων.
vulg: porro quadraginta cubitorum erat ipsum templum pro foribus oraculi
clem: Porro quadraginta cubitorum erat ipsum templum pro foribus oraculi.
kjv: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.

wlc: וְאֶרֶז אֶל־הַבַּיִת פְּנִימָה מִקְלַעַת פְּקָעִים וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים הַכֹּל אֶרֶז אֵין אֶבֶן נִרְאָה ׃
lxx: καὶ τεσσεράκοντα πηχῶν ἦν ὁ ναὸς κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ δαβεὶρ ἐν μέςῳ τοῦ οἴκου ἔσωθεν, δοῦναι ἐκεῖ τὴν κιβωτν διαθήκης Κυρίου.
vulg: et cedro omnis domus intrinsecus vestiebatur habens tornaturas suas et iuncturas fabrefactas et celaturas eminentes omnia cedrinis tabulis vestiebantur nec omnino lapis apparere poterat in pariete
clem: Et cedro omnis domus intrinsecus vestiebatur, habens tornaturas et juncturas suas fabrefactas, et cælaturas eminentes: omnia cedrinis tabulis vestiebantur: nec omnino lapis apparere poterat in pariete.
kjv: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.

wlc: וּדְבִיר בְּתוֹךְ־הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה הֵכִין לְתִתֵּן שָׁם אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית יְהוָה ׃
lxx: εἴκοσι πήχεις μῆκος, καὶ εἴκοσι πήχεις πλάτος, καὶ εἴκοσι πήχεις τὸ ὕψος αὐτοῦ.
vulg: oraculum autem in medio domus in interiori parte fecerat ut poneret ibi arcam foederis Domini
clem: Oraculum autem in medio domus, in interiori parte fecerat, ut poneret ibi arcam fœderis Domini.
kjv: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the Lord.

wlc: וְלִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר עֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה אֹרֶךְ וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה רֹחַב וְעֶשְׂרִים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב סָגוּר וַיְצַף מִזְבֵּחַ אָרֶז ׃
lxx: καὶ περιέσχεν αὐτὸν χρυσίῳ συνκεκλεισμένῳ· καὶ ἐποίησεν θυσιαστήριον κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ δαβεὶρ καὶ περιέσχεν αὐτὸν χρυσίῳ.
vulg: porro oraculum habebat viginti cubitos longitudinis et viginti cubitos latitudinis et viginti cubitos altitudinis et operuit illud atque vestivit auro purissimo sed et altare vestivit cedro
clem: Porro oraculum habebat viginti cubitos longitudinis, et viginti cubitos latitudinis, et viginti cubitos altitudinis: et operuit illud atque vestivit auro purissimo: sed et altare vestivit cedro.
kjv: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.

wlc: וַיְצַף שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־הַבַּיִת מִפְּנִימָה זָהָב סָגוּר וַיְעַבֵּר בְּרַתִּיקוֹת זָהָב לִפְנֵי הַדְּבִיר וַיְצַפֵּהוּ זָהָב ׃
lxx: και ὅλον τὸν οἶκον περιέσχεν χρυσίῳ ἕως συντελείας παντὸς του οἴκου.
vulg: domum quoque ante oraculum operuit auro purissimo et adfixit lamminas clavis aureis
clem: Domum quoque ante oraculum operuit auro purissimo, et affixit laminas clavis aureis.
kjv: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.

wlc: וְאֶת־כָּל־הַבַּיִת צִפָּה זָהָב עַד־תֹּם כָּל־הַבָּיִת וְכָל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר־לַדְּבִיר צִפָּה זָהָב ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐποίησεν εν τῷ δαβεὶρ δύο χερουβεὶν δέκα πήχεων χεων μέγεθος ἐσταθμωμένον.
vulg: nihilque erat in templo quod non auro tegeretur sed et totum altare oraculi texit auro
clem: Nihilque erat in templo quod non auro tegeretur: sed et totum altare oraculi texit auro.
kjv: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.

wlc: וַיַּעַשׂ בַּדְּבִיר שְׁנֵי כְרוּבִים עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת קוֹמָתוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ πέντε πήχεων πτερύγιον αὐτοῦ· τὸ δεύτερον δὲ ἐν πήχει δέκα ἀπο μέρους πτερυγίου αὐτοῦ.
vulg: et fecit in oraculo duo cherubin de lignis olivarum decem cubitorum altitudinis
clem: Et fecit in oraculo duos cherubim de lignis olivarum, decem cubitorum altitudinis.
kjv: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.

wlc: וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת כְּנַף הַכְּרוּב הָאֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת כְּנַף הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִית עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת מִקְצוֹת כְּנָפָיו וְעַד־קְצוֹת כְּנָפָיו ׃
lxx: οὕτως τῷ χεροὺς τῷ δευτέρῳ, ἐν μέτρῳ ἑνὶ συντέλεια μία· ἀμφοτέροις συντέλεια μία·
vulg: quinque cubitorum ala cherub una et quinque cubitorum ala cherub altera id est decem cubitos habentes a summitate alae usque ad alae alterius summitatem
clem: Quinque cubitorum ala cherub una, et quinque cubitorum ala cherub altera: id est, decem cubitos habentes, a summitate alæ unius usque ad alæ alterius summitatem.
kjv: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.

wlc: וְעֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי מִדָּה אַחַת וְקֶצֶב אֶחָד לִשְׁנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים ׃
lxx: καὶ τὸ ὕψος τοῦ χερουβεὶν ἐν πήει, καὶ οὕτως τὸ χερουβεὶν τὸ δεύτερον.
vulg: decem quoque cubitorum erat cherub secundus mensura pari et opus unum erat in duobus cherubin
clem: Decem quoque cubitorum erat cherub secundus: in mensura pari, et opus unum erat in duobus cherubim,
kjv: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.

wlc: קוֹמַת הַכְּרוּב הָאֶחָד עֶשֶׂר בָּאַמָּה וְכֵן הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀμφότερα χερουβεὶν ἐν μέςῳ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ ἐσωτάτου· καὶ διεπέτασεν τὰς πτέρυγας αὐτῶν, καὶ ἥπτετο πτέρυξ μία τοῦ τοίχου, καὶ πτέρυξ ἥυπτετο τοῦ τοίχου τοῦ δευτέρου· αἱ πτέρυγες αὐτοῦ αἱ ἐν μέςῶ τοῦ οἴκου ἥπτοντο πτέρυξ πτέρυγος.
vulg: id est altitudinem habebat unus cherub decem cubitorum et similiter cherub secundus
clem: id est, altitudinem habebat unus cherub decem cubitorum, et similiter cherub secundus.
kjv: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.

wlc: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִים בְּתוֹךְ הַבַּיִת הַפְּנִימִי וַיִּפְרְשׂוּ אֶת־כַּנְפֵי הַכְּרֻבִים וַתִּגַּע כְּנַף־הָאֶחָד בַּקִּיר וּכְנַף הַכְּרוּב הַשֵּׁנִי נֹגַעַת בַּקִּיר הַשֵּׁנִי וְכַנְפֵיהֶם אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַבַּיִת נֹגְעֹת כָּנָף אֶל־כָּנָף ׃
lxx: καὶ περιέσχεν τὰ χερουβεὶν χρυσίῳ.
vulg: posuitque cherubin in medio templi interioris extendebant autem alas suas cherubin et tangebat ala una parietem et ala cherub secundi tangebat parietem alterum alae autem alterae in media parte templi se invicem contingebant
clem: Posuitque cherubim in medio templi interioris: extendebant autem alas suas cherubim, et tangebat ala una parietem, et ala cherub secundi tangebat parietem alterum: alæ autem alteræ in media parte templi se invicem contingebant.
kjv: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.

wlc: וַיְצַף אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִים זָהָב ׃
lxx: πάντας τοὺς τοίχους τοῦ οἴκου κύκλῳ ἐκκολαπτὰ ἔγραψεν γραφίδι χερουβείν, καὶ φοίνικες τῷ ἐσωτέρῳ καὶ τῷ ἐξωτέρῳ.
vulg: texit quoque cherubin auro
clem: Texit quoque cherubim auro.
kjv: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.

wlc: וְאֵת כָּל־קִירוֹת הַבַּיִת מֵסַב קָלַע פִּתּוּחֵי מִקְלְעוֹת כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרֹת וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים מִלִּפְנִים וְלַחִיצוֹן ׃
lxx: καὶ τὸ ἔδαφος τοῦ οἴκου περιέσχεν χρυσίῳ, τοῦ ἐσωτάτου καὶ τοῦ ἐξωτάτου.
vulg: et omnes parietes templi per circuitum scalpsit variis celaturis et torno et fecit in eis cherubin et palmas et picturas varias quasi prominentes de pariete et egredientes
clem: Et omnes parietes templi per circuitum sculpsit variis cælaturis et torno: et fecit in eis cherubim, et palmas, et picturas varias, quasi prominentes de pariete, et egredientes.
kjv: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.

wlc: וְאֶת־קַרְקַע הַבַּיִת צִפָּה זָהָב לִפְנִימָה וְלַחִיצוֹן ׃
lxx: καὶ τῷ θυρώματι τοῦ δυβεὶρ ἐποίησεν θύρας ξυλίνων ἀρκευθίνων·
vulg: sed et pavimentum domus texit auro intrinsecus et extrinsecus
clem: Sed et pavimentum domus texit auro intrinsecus et extrinsecus.
kjv: And the floors of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.

wlc: וְאֵת פֶּתַח הַדְּבִיר עָשָׂה דַּלְתוֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן הָאַיִל מְזוּזוֹת חֲמִשִׁית ׃
lxx: στοαὶ τετραπλῶς.
vulg: et in ingressu oraculi fecit ostiola de lignis olivarum postesque angulorum quinque
clem: Et in ingressu oraculi fecit ostiola de lignis olivarum, postesque angulorum quinque.
kjv: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.

wlc: וּשְׁתֵּי דַּלְתוֹת עֲצֵי־שֶׁמֶן וְקָלַע עֲלֵיהֶם מִקְלְעוֹת כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרוֹת וּפְטוּרֵי צִצִּים וְצִפָּה זָהָב וַיָּרֶד עַל־הַכְּרוּבִים וְעַל־הַתִּמֹרוֹת אֶת־הַזָּהָב ׃
lxx: ἐν ἀμφοτέραις ταῖς θύραις ξύλα πεύκινα. δύο πτυχαὶ καὶ ἡ θύρα ἡ μία καὶ στροφεῖς αὐτῶν, καὶ δύο πιυχαὶ ἡ θύρα ἡ Δευτέρα, στρεφόμενα.
vulg: et duo ostia de lignis olivarum et scalpsit in eis picturam cherubin et palmarum species et anaglyfa valde prominentia et texit ea auro et operuit tam cherubin quam palmas et cetera auro
clem: Et duo ostia de lignis olivarum: et sculpsit in eis picturam cherubim, et palmarum species, et anaglypha valde prominentia: et texit ea auro, et operuit tam cherubim quam palmas, et cetera, auro.
kjv: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.

wlc: וְכֵן עָשָׂה לְפֶתַח הַהֵיכָל מְזוּזוֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁמֶן מֵאֵת רְבִעִית ׃
lxx: ἐκκεκολαμμένα χερουβεὶν καὶ φοίνικες καὶ διαπεπετασμένα πέταλα, καὶ περιεχόμενα χρυσίῳ καταγομένῳ ἐπὶ τὴν ἐκτύπωσιν.
vulg: fecitque in introitum templi postes de lignis olivarum quadrangulatos
clem: Fecitque in introitu templi postes de lignis olivarum quadrangulatos,
kjv: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.

wlc: וּשְׁתֵּי דַלְתוֹת עֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים שְׁנֵי צְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הָאַחַת גְּלִילִים וּשְׁנֵי קְלָעִים הַדֶּלֶת הַשֵּׁנִית גְּלִילִים ׃
lxx: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν αὐλὴν τὴν ἐσωτάτην, τρεῖς στίχους ἀπελεκήτων, καὶ στίχος κατειργασμένης κέθρου κυκλόθεν. καὶ ᾠ κοδόμησε καταπέτασμα τῆς αὐλῆς τοῦ αἰλὰμ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ κατὰ π ρόσωπον τοῦ ναοῦ.
vulg: et duo ostia de lignis abiegnis altrinsecus et utrumque ostium duplex erat et se invicem tenens aperiebatur
clem: et duo ostia de lignis abiegnis altrinsecus: et utrumque ostium duplex erat, et se invicem tenens aperiebatur.
kjv: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

wlc: וְקָלַע כְּרוּבִים וְתִמֹרוֹת וּפְטֻרֵי צִצִּים וְצִפָּה זָהָב מְיֻשָּׁר עַל־הַמְּחֻקֶּה ׃
vulg: et scalpsit cherubin et palmas et celaturas valde eminentes operuitque omnia lamminis aureis opere quadro ad regulam
clem: Et sculpsit cherubim, et palmas, et cælaturas valde eminentes: operuitque omnia laminis aureis opere quadro ad regulam.
kjv: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.

wlc: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הֶחָצֵר הַפְּנִימִית שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרֵי גָזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִים ׃
vulg: et aedificavit atrium interius tribus ordinibus lapidum politorum et uno ordine lignorum cedri
clem: Et ædificavit atrium interius tribus ordinibus lapidum politorum, et uno ordine lignorum cedri.
kjv: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.

wlc: בַּשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִית יֻסַּד בֵּית יְהוָה בְּיֶרַח זִו ׃
vulg: anno quarto fundata est domus Domini in mense zio
clem: Anno quarto fundata est domus Domini in mense Zio:
kjv: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the Lord laid, in the month Zif:

wlc: וּבַשָּׁנָה הָאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה בְּיֶרַח בּוּל הוּא הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִי כָּלָה הַבַּיִת לְכָל־דְּבָרָיו וּלְכָל־מִשְׁפָּטוֹ וַיִּבְנֵהוּ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים ׃
vulg: et in anno undecimo mense bul ipse est mensis octavus perfecta est domus in omni opere suo et in universis utensilibus aedificavitque eam annis septem
clem: et in anno undecimo, mense Bul (ipse est mensis octavus), perfecta est domus in omni opere suo, et in universis utensilibus suis: ædificavitque eam annis septem.
kjv: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.

wlc: וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיְכַל אֶת־כָּל־בֵּיתוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμὼν καὶ ἔλαβεν τὸν Χειρὰμ ἐκ Τύρου,
vulg: domum autem suam aedificavit Salomon tredecim annis et ad perfectum usque perduxit
clem: Domum autem suam ædificavit Salomon tredecim annis, et ad perfectum usque perduxit.
kjv: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

wlc: וַיִּבֶן אֶת־בֵּית יַעַר הַלְּבָנוֹן מֵאָה אַמָּה אָרְכּוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה רָחְבּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה קוֹמָתוֹ עַל אַרְבָּעָה טוּרֵי עַמּוּדֵי אֲרָזִים וּכְרֻתוֹת אֲרָזִים עַל־הָעַמּוּדִים ׃
lxx: υἰὸν γυναικὸς χήρας, καὶ οὖτος ἀπὸ τῆς φθυλῆς Νεφθαλεί, καὶ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἀνὴρ Τύριος, τέκτων χαλκοῦ καὶ πεπληρωμένος τῆς τέχνης καὶ συνέσεως καὶ γνώσεως τοῦ ποιεῖν πᾶν ἔργον ἐν χαλκῷ. καὶ εἰσηνέχθη πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Σαλωμών, καὶ ἐποίησεν πάντα τὰ ἔργα.
vulg: aedificavit quoque domum saltus Libani centum cubitorum longitudinis et quinquaginta cubitorum latitudinis et triginta cubitorum altitudinis et quattuor deambulacra inter columnas cedrinas ligna quippe cedrina exciderat in columnas
clem: Ædificavit quoque domum saltus Libani centum cubitorum longitudinis, et quinquaginta cubitorum latitudinis, et triginta cubitorum altitudinis: et quatuor deambulacra inter columnas cedrinas: ligna quippe cedrina exciderat in columnas.
kjv: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.

wlc: וְסָפֻן בָּאֶרֶז מִמַּעַל עַל־הַצְּלָעֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־הָעַמּוּדִים אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר הַטּוּר ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐχώνευσεν τὸ αἰλὰμ τοῦ οἴκου, ὀκτὼ καὶ δέκα πήχεις ὔψος τοῦ στύλου. καὶ περίμετρον τέσσαρες καὶ δέκα πήχεις ἐκύκλου αὐτόν,τὸ πάχος τοῦ στύλου. τεσσάρων δακτύλων δακτύλων τὰ κοιλώματα. καὶ οὕτως στύλος ὁ δεύτερος.
vulg: et tabulatis cedrinis vestivit totam cameram quae quadraginta quinque columnis sustentabatur unus autem ordo habebat columnas quindecim
clem: Et tabulatis cedrinis vestivit totam cameram, quæ quadraginta quinque columnis sustentabatur. Unus autem ordo habebat columnas quindecim
kjv: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.

wlc: וּשְׁקֻפִים שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים וּמֶחֱזָה אֶל־מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים ׃
lxx: καὶ δύο ἐπιθέματα ἐποίησεν, δοῦναι ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς τῶν στύλων, χωνευτά. πέντε πήδχεις τὸ ὕψος τοῦ ἐπιθέματος τοῦ ἑνός.
vulg: contra se invicem positas
clem: contra se invicem positas,
kjv: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.

wlc: וְכָל־הַפְּתָחִים וְהַמְּזוּזוֹת רְבֻעִים שָׁקֶף וּמוּל מֶחֱזָה אֶל־מֶחֱזָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐποίησεν δύο δίκτυα περικαλύψαι τὸ ἐπίθεμα τῶν στύλων, καὶ δίκτυον τῷ ἐπιθέματι τῷ ἑνὶ καὶ δίκτυον τῷ ἐπιθέματι τῷ δυτέρῳ.
vulg: et e regione se respicientes aequali spatio inter columnas et super columnas quadrangulata ligna in cunctis aequalia
clem: et e regione se respicientes, æquali spatio inter columnas, et super columnas quadrangulata ligna in cunctis æqualia.
kjv: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.

wlc: וְאֵת אוּלָם הָעַמּוּדִים עָשָׂה חֲמִשִּׁים אַמָּה אָרְכּוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אַמָּה רָחְבּוֹ וְאוּלָם עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם וְעַמֻּדִים וְעָב עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἔργον κρεμαστόν, δύο στίχοι ῥοῶν χαλκῶν δεδικτυωμένοι, ἔργον κρεμαστόν, στίχος ἐπὶ στίχον. καὶ οὕτως τοῦ αἰλὰμ τῷ ἐπιθέματι τῷ δευτέρῳ.
vulg: et porticum columnarum fecit quinquaginta cubitorum longitudinis et triginta cubitorum latitudinis et alteram porticum in facie maioris porticus et columnas et epistylia super columnas
clem: Et porticum columnarum fecit quinquaginta cubitorum longitudinis, et triginta cubitorum latitudinis: et alteram porticum in facie majoris porticus: et columnas, et epistylia super columnas.
kjv: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.

wlc: וְאוּלָם הַכִּסֵּא אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁפָּט־שָׁם אֻלָם הַמִּשְׁפָּט עָשָׂה וְסָפוּן בָּאֶרֶז מֵהַקַּרְקַע עַד־הַקַּרְקָע ׃
lxx: καὶ ἔστησεν τοὺς στύλους τοῦ αἰλὰμ τοῦ ναοῦ. καὶ ἔστησεν τὸν στύλον τὸν ἕνα καὶ ἐπεκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰαχούμ, καὶ ἔστησεν τὸν στύλον τὸν δεύτερον καὶ ἐπεκάλεσεν τὸ ὅνομα αὐτοῦ Βάλαζ.
vulg: porticum quoque solii in qua tribunal est fecit et texit lignis cedrinis a pavimento usque ad summitatem
clem: Porticum quoque solii, in qua tribunal est, fecit: et texit lignis cedrinis a pavimento usque ad summitatem.
kjv: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.

wlc: וּבֵיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֶׁב שָׁם חָצֵר הָאַחֶרֶת מִבֵּית לָאוּלָם כַּמַּעֲשֶׂה הַזֶּה הָיָה וּבַיִת יַעֲשֶׂה לְבַת־פַּרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר לָקַח שְׁלֹמֹה כָּאוּלָם הַזֶּה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν καφαλῶν τῶν στύλων ἔγρον κρίνου κατὰ τὸ αἰλὰμ τεσσάρων πηχῶν.
vulg: et domuncula in qua sedetur ad iudicandum erat in media porticu simili opere domum quoque fecit filiae Pharaonis quam uxorem duxerat Salomon tali opere quali et hanc porticum
clem: Et domuncula, in qua sedebatur ad judicandum, erat in media porticu simili opere. Domum quoque fecit filiæ Pharaonis (quam uxorem duxerat Salomon) tali opere, quali et hanc porticum.
kjv: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.

wlc: כָּל־אֵלֶּה אֲבָנִים יְקָרֹת כְּמִדֹּת גָּזִית מְגֹרָרוֹת בַּמְּגֵרָה מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ וּמִמַּסָּד עַד־הַטְּפָחוֹת וּמִחוּץ עַד־הֶחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָה ׃
lxx: καὶ μέλαθρον ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρων τῶν στύλων, καὶ ἐπάνωθεν τῶν πλευρῶν ἐπίθεμα τό μέλαθρον τῷ πήχει.
vulg: omnia lapidibus pretiosis qui ad normam quandam atque mensuram tam intrinsecus quam extrinsecus serrati erant a fundamento usque ad summitatem parietum et intrinsecus usque ad atrium maius
clem: Omnia lapidibus pretiosis, qui ad normam quamdam atque mensuram tam intrinsecus quam extrinsecus serrati erant: a fundamento usque ad summitatem parietum, et extrinsecus usque ad atrium majus.
kjv: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.

wlc: וּמְיֻסָּד אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת אֲבָנִים גְּדֹלוֹת אַבְנֵי עֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת וְאַבְנֵי שְׁמֹנֶה אַמּוֹת ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὴν θάλασσαν δέκα ἐν πήχει ἀπὸ τοῦ τείχους αὐτῆς ἕως τοῦ χείλους αὐτῆς, στρογγύλον κύκλῳ τὸ αὐτό· πέντε ἐν πήχει τὸ ὕψος αὐτῆς, καὶ συνηγμένοι τρεῖς καὶ τριάκοντα ἐν πήχει.
vulg: fundamenta autem de lapidibus pretiosis lapidibus magnis decem sive octo cubitorum
clem: Fundamenta autem de lapidibus pretiosis, lapidibus magnis, decem sive octo cubitorum.
kjv: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.

wlc: וּמִלְמַעְלָה אֲבָנִים יְקָרוֹת כְּמִדּוֹת גָּזִית וָאָרֶז ׃
lxx: καὶ ὑποστηρίγματα ὑποκάτωθεν τοῦ χείλους αὐτῆς κυκλόθεν ἐκύκλουν αὐτὴν δέκα ἐν πήχει κυκλόθεν·
vulg: et desuper lapides pretiosi aequalis mensurae secti erant similiterque de cedro
clem: Et desuper lapides pretiosi æqualis mensuræ secti erant, similiterque de cedro.
kjv: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.

wlc: וְחָצֵר הַגְּדוֹלָה סָבִיב שְׁלֹשָׁה טוּרִים גָּזִית וְטוּר כְּרֻתֹת אֲרָזִים וְלַחֲצַר בֵּית־יְהוָה הַפְּנִימִית וּלְאֻלָם הַבָּיִת ׃
lxx: καὶ τὸ χεῖλος αὐτῆς ὡς ἔργον χείλους ποτηρίου, βλαστὸς κρίνου, καὶ τὸ πάχος αὐτοῦ παλαιστής.
vulg: et atrium maius rotundum trium ordinum de lapidibus sectis et unius ordinis dolata cedro necnon et in atrio domus Domini interiori et in porticu domus
clem: Et atrium majus rotundum trium ordinum de lapidibus sectis, et unius ordinis de dolata cedro: necnon et in atrio domus Domini interiori, et in porticu domus.
kjv: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the Lord, and for the porch of the house.

wlc: פ וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חִירָם מִצֹּר ׃
lxx: καὶ δώδεκα βόες ὑποκάτω τῆς θαλάσσης, οἱ τρεῖς ἐπιβλέποντες βορρᾶν, καὶ οἱ τρεῖς ἐπιβλέποντες θάλασσαν, καἰ οἱ τρεῖς ἐπιβλέποντες νότον, καὶ οἱ τρεῖς ἐπιβλέποντες ἀνατολήν. καὶ πάντα τὰ ὀπίσθια εἰς τὸν οἶκον, καὶ ἡ θάλασσα ἐπ’ αὐτῶν ἐπάνωθεν.
vulg: misit quoque rex Salomon et tulit Hiram de Tyro
clem: Misit quoque rex Salomon, et tulit Hiram de Tyro,
kjv: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.

wlc: בֶּן־אִשָּׁה אַלְמָנָה הוּא מִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וְאָבִיו אִישׁ־צֹרִי חֹרֵשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וַיִּמָּלֵא אֶת־הַחָכְמָה וְאֶת־הַתְּבוּנָה וְאֶת־הַדַּעַת לַעֲשׂוֹת כָּל־מְלָאכָה בַּנְּחֹשֶׁת וַיָּבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיַּעַשׂ אֶת־כָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐποίησεν δέκα μεχωνὼθ χαλκᾶς· πέντε πήχεις μῆκος τῆς μεχωνὼθ τῆς μιᾶς, καὶ τέσσαρες πήχεις πλάτος αὐτῆς, καὶ ἓξ ἐν πήχει ὕψος αὐτῆς.
vulg: filium mulieris viduae de tribu Nepthali patre Tyrio artificem aerarium et plenum sapientia et intellegentia et doctrina ad faciendum omne opus ex aere qui cum venisset ad regem Salomonem fecit omne opus eius
clem: filium mulieris viduæ de tribu Nephthali, patre Tyrio, artificem ærarium, et plenum sapientia, et intelligentia, et doctrina, ad faciendum omne opus ex ære. Qui cum venisset ad regem Salomonem, fecit omne opus ejus.
kjv: He was a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.

wlc: וַיָּצַר אֶת־שְׁנֵי הָעַמּוּדִים נְחֹשֶׁת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קוֹמַת הָעַמּוּד הָאֶחָד וְחוּט שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה יָסֹב אֶת־הָעַמּוּד הַשֵּׁנִי ׃
lxx: καὶ τοῦτο τὸ ἔργον τῶν μεχωνώθ. συνκλειστὸν αὐτοῖς, καὶ συνκλειστὸν ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ἐξεχομένων.
vulg: et finxit duas columnas aereas decem et octo cubitorum altitudinis columnam unam et linea duodecim cubitorum ambiebat columnam utramque
clem: Et finxit duas columnas æreas, decem et octo cubitorum altitudinis columnam unam: et linea duodecim cubitorum ambiebat columnam utramque.
kjv: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.

wlc: וּשְׁתֵּי כֹתָרֹת עָשָׂה לָתֵת עַל־רָאשֵׁי הָעַמּוּדִים מֻצַק נְחֹשֶׁת חָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הָאֶחָת וְחָמֵשׁ אַמּוֹת קוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת הַשֵּׁנִית ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ συνκλείσματα αὐτῶν ἀνὰ μέσον ἐξεχομένων λέοντες καὶ βόες καὶ χερουβείν· καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ἐξεχομένων οὕτως καὶ ἐπάνωθεν, καὶ ὑποκάτωθεν τῶν λεόντων καὶ τῶν βοῶν χῶραι, ἔργον καταβάσεως.
vulg: duo quoque capitella fecit quae ponerentur super capita columnarum fusili aere quinque cubitorum altitudinis capitellum unum et quinque cubitorum altitudinis capitellum alterum
