lxx: καὶ πάντες οἱ προφῆται ἐπροφήτευον οὔτως λέγοντες Ἀνάβαινε εἰς Ῥεμμὰθ Γαλαάδ, καὶ εὐοδώσει· καὶ δώσει Κύριος εἰς χεῖράς σου καὶ τὸν βασιλέα Συρίας.
vulg: omnesque prophetae similiter prophetabant dicentes ascende in Ramoth Galaad et vade prospere et tradet Dominus in manu regis
clem: Omnesque prophetæ similiter prophetabant, dicentes: Ascende in Ramoth Galaad, et vade prospere, et tradet Dominus in manus regis.
kjv: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the Lord shall deliver it into the king's hand.

wlc: וְהַמַּלְאָךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ לִקְרֹא מִיכָיְהוּ דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה־נָא דִּבְרֵי הַנְּבִיאִים פֶּה־אֶחָד טוֹב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהִי־נָא דִבְרֵיךָ כִּדְבַר אַחַד מֵהֶם וְדִבַּרְתָּ טּוֹב ׃
lxx: καὶ ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ πορευθεὶς καλέσαι τὸν Μειχαίαν ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ λέγων Ἰδοὺ δὴ λαλοῦσιν πάντες οἱ προφῆται ἐν στόματι ἐπὶ καλὰ κατὰ τοῦ βασιλέως· γίνου δὴ καὶ σὺ εὶς λόγους σου εἶς κατὰ τοὺς λόγους ἑνὸς τούτων, καὶ λάλησον καλά.
vulg: nuntius vero qui ierat ut vocaret Micheam locutus est ad eum dicens ecce sermones prophetarum ore uno bona regi praedicant sit ergo et sermo tuus similis eorum et loquere bona
clem: Nuntius vero qui ierat ut vocaret Michæam, locutus est ad eum, dicens: Ecce sermones prophetarum ore uno regi bona prædicant: sit ergo sermo tuus similis eorum, et loquere bona.
kjv: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ חַי־יְהוָה כִּי אֶת־אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַר יְהוָה אֵלַי אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν Μειχαίας Ζῇ Κύριος ὅτι ἃ ἃν εἴπῃ Κύριος πρὸς μέ, ταῦτα λαλήσω.
vulg: cui Micheas ait vivit Dominus quia quodcumque dixerit mihi Dominus hoc loquar
clem: Cui Michæas ait: Vivit Dominus, quia quodcumque dixerit mihi Dominus, hoc loquar.
kjv: And Micaiah said, As the Lord liveth, what the Lord saith unto me, that will I speak.

wlc: וַיָּבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו מִיכָיְהוּ הֲנֵלֵךְ אֶל־רָמֹת גִּלְעָד לַמִּלְחָמָה אִם־נֶחְדָּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו עֲלֵה וְהַצְלַח וְנָתַן יְהוָה בְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς Μειχαία, εἰ ἀναβῳ εἰς Ῥεμμὰθ Γαλαὰδ εἰς πόλεμον ἢ ἐπίσχω; καὶ εἶπεν Ἀνάβαινε, καὶ εὐοκώσει Κύριος εἰς χεῖρα τοῦ βασιλέως.
vulg: venit itaque ad regem et ait illi rex Michea ire debemus in Ramoth Galaad ad proeliandum an cessare cui ille respondit ascende et vade prospere et tradet Dominus in manu regis
clem: Venit itaque ad regem, et ait illi rex: Michæa, ire debemus in Ramoth Galaad ad præliandum, an cessare? Cui ille respondit: Ascende, et vade prospere, et tradet eam Dominus in manus regis.
kjv: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הַמֶּלֶךְ עַד־כַּמֶּה פְעָמִים אֲנִי מַשְׁבִּעֶךָ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תְדַבֵּר אֵלַי רַק־אֱמֶת בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς Πεντάκις ἐγὼ ἐξορκίζω σε ὅπως λαλαήσῃς πρὸς μὲ ἀλήθειαν ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου.
vulg: dixit autem rex ad eum iterum atque iterum adiuro te ut non loquaris mihi nisi quod verum est in nomine Domini
clem: Dixit autem rex ad eum: Iterum atque iterum adjuro te, ut non loquaris mihi nisi quod verum est, in nomine Domini.
kjv: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the Lord?

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר רָאִיתִי אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נְפֹצִים אֶל־הֶהָרִים כַּצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר אֵין־לָהֶם רֹעֶה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה לֹא־אֲדֹנִים לָאֵלֶּה יָשׁוּבוּ אִישׁ־לְבֵיתוֹ בְּשָׁלוֹם ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν Οὐκ οὕτως· ἑώρακα τὸν πάντα Ἰσραὴλ δεισπαρμένους ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν ὡς ποίμνιον ᾧ οὐκ ἔστι ποιμήν· καὶ εἶπεν Κύριος Οὐ Κύριος τούτοις θεός; ἕκαστος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ ἐν εἰρήνῃ ἀναστρεφέτω.
vulg: et ille ait vidi cunctum Israhel dispersum in montibus quasi oves non habentes pastorem et ait Dominus non habent dominum isti revertatur unusquisque in domum suam in pace
clem: Et ille ait: Vidi cunctum Israël dispersum in montibus, quasi oves non habentes pastorem. Et ait Dominus: Non habent isti dominum: revertatur unusquisque in domum suam in pace.
kjv: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the Lord said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט הֲלוֹא אָמַרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לוֹא־יִתְנַבֵּא עָלַי טוֹב כִּי אִם־רָע ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ πρὸς Ἰωσαφὰτ βασιλέα Ἰούδα Οὐκ εἶπα πρὸς σέ Οὐ προφητεύει οὗτός μοι καλά, διότι ἀλλ’ ἢ κακά;
vulg: dixit ergo rex Israhel ad Iosaphat numquid non dixi tibi quia non prophetat mihi bonum sed semper malum
clem: (Dixit ergo rex Israël ad Josaphat: Numquid non dixi tibi, quia non prophetat mihi bonum, sed semper malum?)
kjv: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר לָכֵן שְׁמַע דְּבַר־יְהוָה רָאִיתִי אֶת־יְהוָה יֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וְכָל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם עֹמֵד עָלָיו מִימִינוֹ וּמִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν Μειχαίας Οὐχ οὕτως, οὐκ ἐγώ· ἄκουε ῥῆμα Κυρίου· οὐχ οὕτως. εἶδον θεὸν Ἰσραὴλ καθήμενον ἐπὶ θρόνου αὐτοῦ, καὶ πᾶσα ἡ στρατεία τοῦ οὐρανοῦ εἱστήκει περὶ αὐτὸν ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξ εὐωνύμων αὐτοῦ.
vulg: ille vero addens ait propterea audi sermonem Domini vidi Dominum sedentem super solium suum et omnem exercitum caeli adsistentem ei a dextris et a sinistris
clem: Ille vero addens, ait: Propterea audi sermonem Domini: vidi Dominum sedentem super solium suum, et omnem exercitum cæli assistentem ei a dextris et a sinistris:
kjv: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the Lord: I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה מִי יְפַתֶּה אֶת־אַחְאָב וְיַעַל וְיִפֹּל בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר זֶה בְּכֹה וְזֶה אֹמֵר בְּכֹה ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν Κύριος Τίς ἀπατήσει τὸν Ἀχαὰβ βασιλέα Ἰσραήλ, καὶ ἀναβήσεται καὶ πεσεῖται ἐν Ῥεμμὰθ Γαλαάδ; καὶ εἶπεν οὗτος οὕτως, καὶ οὗτος οὕτως.
vulg: et ait Dominus quis decipiet Ahab regem Israhel ut ascendat et cadat in Ramoth Galaad et dixit unus verba huiuscemodi et alius aliter
clem: et ait Dominus: Quis decipiet Achab regem Israël, ut ascendat, et cadat in Ramoth Galaad? Et dixit unus verba hujuscemodi, et alius aliter.
kjv: And the Lord said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.

wlc: וַיֵּצֵא הָרוּחַ וַיַּעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי אֲפַתֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָיו בַּמָּה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν πνεῦμα καὶ ἔστη ἐνωπιον Κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν Ἐγὼ ἀπατήσω αὐτόν.
vulg: egressus est autem spiritus et stetit coram Domino et ait ego decipiam illum cui locutus est Dominus in quo
clem: Egressus est autem spiritus, et stetit coram Domino, et ait: Ego decipiam illum. Cui locutus est Dominus: In quo?
kjv: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the Lord, and said, I will persuade him.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵצֵא וְהָיִיתִי רוּחַ שֶׁקֶר בְּפִי כָּל־נְבִיאָיו וַיֹּאמֶר תְּפַתֶּה וְגַם־תּוּכָל צֵא וַעֲשֵׂה־כֵן ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Κύριος Ἐν τίνι; καὶ εἶπεν Ἐξελεύσομαι καὶ ἔσομαι πνεῦμα ψευδὲς εἰς τὸ στόμα πάντων τῶν προφητῶν αὐτοῦ· καὶ εἶπεν Ἀπατήσεις καί γε δυνήσει· ἔξελθε καὶ ποίησον οὕτως.
vulg: et ille ait egrediar et ero spiritus mendax in ore omnium prophetarum eius et dixit Dominus decipies et praevalebis egredere et fac ita
clem: Et ille ait: Egrediar, et ero spiritus mendax in ore omnium prophetarum ejus. Et dixit Dominus: Decipies, et prævalebis: egredere, et fac ita.
kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.

wlc: וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה נָתַן יְהוָה רוּחַ שֶׁקֶר בְּפִי כָּל־נְבִיאֶיךָ אֵלֶּה וַיהוָה דִּבֶּר עָלֶיךָ רָעָה ׃
lxx: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ ἔδωκεν Κύριος πνεῦμα ψευδὲς ἐν στόματι πάντων τῶν προφητῶν σου τούτων, καὶ Κύριος ἐλάλησεν ἐπὶ σὲ κακά.
vulg: nunc igitur ecce dedit Dominus spiritum mendacii in ore omnium prophetarum tuorum qui hic sunt et Dominus locutus est contra te malum
clem: Nunc igitur ecce dedit Dominus spiritum mendacii in ore omnium prophetarum tuorum, qui hic sunt, et Dominus locutus est contra te malum.
kjv: Now therefore, behold, the Lord hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the Lord hath spoken evil concerning thee.

wlc: וַיִּגַּשׁ צִדְקִיָּהוּ בֶן־כְּנַעֲנָה וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־מִיכָיְהוּ עַל־הַלֶּחִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵי־זֶה עָבַר רוּחַ־יְהוָה מֵאִתִּי לְדַבֵּר אוֹתָךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ προσῆλθεν Σεδεκιοὺ υἱὸς Χανάαν καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν Μειχαίαν ἐπὶ τὴν σιαγόνα καὶ εἶπεν Ποῖον πνεῦμα Κυρίου τὸ λαλῆσαν ἐν σοί;
vulg: accessit autem Sedecias filius Chanaan et percussit Micheam in maxillam et dixit mene ergo dimisit spiritus Domini et locutus est tibi
clem: Accessit autem Sedecias filius Chanaana, et percussit Michæam in maxillam, et dixit: Mene ergo dimisit spiritus Domini, et locutus est tibi?
kjv: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the Lord from me to speak unto thee?

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ הִנְּךָ רֹאֶה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר תָּבֹא חֶדֶר בְּחֶדֶר לְהֵחָבֵה ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν μειχαίας Ἰδοὺ σὺ ὄψῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ὅταν εἰσέλθῃς ταμεῖον τοῦ ταμείου τοῦ κρυφίου.
vulg: et ait Micheas visurus es in die illa quando ingredieris cubiculum intra cubiculum ut abscondaris
clem: Et ait Michæas: Visurus es in die illa quando ingredieris cubiculum intra cubiculum ut abscondaris.
kjv: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל קַח אֶת־מִיכָיְהוּ וַהֲשִׁיבֵהוּ אֶל־אָמֹן שַׂר־הָעִיר וְאֶל־יוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἰσραήλ Λάβετε τὸν Μειχαίαν καὶ ἀποστρέψατε αὐτὸν πρὸς Σεμὴρ τὸν βασιλέα τῆς πόλεως· καὶ τῷ Ἰςὰς υἱῷ τοῦ βασιλέως
vulg: et ait rex Israhel tollite Micheam et maneat apud Amon principem civitatis et apud Ioas filium Ammelech
clem: Et ait rex Israël: Tollite Michæam, et maneat apud Amon principem civitatis, et apud Joas filium Amelech,
kjv: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;

wlc: וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ שִׂימוּ אֶת־זֶה בֵּית הַכֶּלֶא וְהַאֲכִילֻהוּ לֶחֶם לַחַץ וּמַיִם לַחַץ עַד בֹּאִי בְשָׁלוֹם ׃
lxx: εἰπὸν θέσθαι τοῦτον ἐν φυλακῇ, καὶ ἐσθίειν αὐτὸν ἄρτον θλίψεως καὶ ὕδωρ θλίψεως ἕως τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι με ἐν ειρήνῃ.
vulg: et dicite eis haec dicit rex mittite virum istum in carcerem et sustentate eum pane tribulationis et aqua angustiae donec revertar in pace
clem: et dicite eis: Hæc dicit rex: Mittite virum istum in carcerem, et sustentate eum pane tribulationis, et aqua angustiæ, donec revertar in pace.
kjv: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ אִם־שׁוֹב תָּשׁוּב בְּשָׁלוֹם לֹא־דִבֶּר יְהוָה בִּי וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעוּ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν Μειχαίας Ἐὰν ἐπιστρέφων ἐπιστρέψῃς ἐν εἰρήνῃ, οὐ λελάσηκεν Κύριος ἐν ἐμοί.
vulg: dixitque Micheas si reversus fueris in pace non est locutus Dominus in me et ait audite populi omnes
clem: Dixitque Michæas: Si reversus fueris in pace, non est locutus in me Dominus. Et ait: Audite, populi omnes.
kjv: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the Lord hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.

wlc: וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה רָמֹת גִּלְעָד ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἀνέβη βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ καὶ Ἰωσαφὰτ βασιλεὺς Ἰούδα μετ᾿ αὐτοῦ εἰς Ῥεμμὰθ Γαλαάδ.
vulg: ascendit itaque rex Israhel et Iosaphat rex Iuda in Ramoth Galaad
clem: Ascendit itaque rex Israël, et Josaphat rex Juda, in Ramoth Galaad.
kjv: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט הִתְחַפֵּשׂ וָבֹא בַמִּלְחָמָה וְאַתָּה לְבַשׁ בְּגָדֶיךָ וַיִּתְחַפֵּשׂ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבוֹא בַּמִּלְחָמָה ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ πρὸς Ἰωσαφὰτ βασιλέα Ἰούδα Συνκαλύψομαι καὶ εἰσελεύσομαι εἰς τὸν πόλεμον, καὶ σὺ ἔνδυσαι τὸν ἱματισμόν μου· καὶ συνεκαλύψατο βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν πόλεμον.
vulg: dixitque rex Israhel ad Iosaphat sume arma et ingredere proelium et induere vestibus tuis porro rex Israhel mutavit habitum et ingressus est bellum
clem: Dixit itaque rex Israël ad Josaphat: Sume arma, et ingredere prælium, et induere vestibus tuis. Porro rex Israël mutavit habitum suum, et ingressus est bellum.
kjv: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.

wlc: וּמֶלֶךְ אֲרָם צִוָּה אֶת־שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁנַיִם לֵאמֹר לֹא תִּלָּחֲמוּ אֶת־קָטֹן וְאֶת־גָּדוֹל כִּי אִם־אֶת־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַדּוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ βασιλεὺς Συρίας ἐνετείλατο τοῖς ἄρχουσι τῶν αρμάτων αὐτοῦ τριάκοντα καὶ δυςὶν λέγων Μὴ πολεμεῖτε μικρὸν καὶ μέγαν ἀλλ᾿ ἢ τὸν βασιλέα Ἰσραὴλ μονώτατον.
vulg: rex autem Syriae praeceperat principibus curruum triginta duobus dicens non pugnabitis contra minorem et maiorem quempiam nisi contra regem Israhel solum
clem: Rex autem Syriæ præceperat principibus curruum triginta duobus, dicens: Non pugnabitis contra minorem et majorem quempiam, nisi contra regem Israël solum.
kjv: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.

wlc: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב אֶת־יְהוֹשָׁפָט וְהֵמָּה אָמְרוּ אַךְ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וַיָּסֻרוּ עָלָיו לְהִלָּחֵם וַיִּזְעַק יְהוֹשָׁפָט ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς εἶδον οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν ἁρμάτων τὸν Ἰωσαφὰθ βασιλέα Ἰούδα, καὶ αὐτοὶ εἶπον Φαίνεται βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ οὗτος· καὶ ἐκύκλωσαν αὐτὸν πολεμῆσαι· καὶ ἀνέκραξεν Ιωσαφάθ.
vulg: cum ergo vidissent principes curruum Iosaphat suspicati sunt quod ipse esset rex Israhel et impetu facto pugnabant contra eum et exclamavit Iosaphat
clem: Cum ergo vidissent principes curruum Josaphat, suspicati sunt quod ipse esset rex Israël, et impetu facto pugnabant contra eum: et exclamavit Josaphat.
kjv: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.

wlc: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב כִּי־לֹא־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא וַיָּשׁוּבוּ מֵאַחֲרָיו ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς εἶδον οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν ἁρμάτων ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ οὗτος, καὶ ἀπεστρεψαν ἀπ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: intellexeruntque principes curruum quod non esset rex Israhel et cessaverunt ab eo
clem: Intellexeruntque principes curruum quod non esset rex Israël, et cessaverunt ab eo.
kjv: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.

wlc: וְאִישׁ מָשַׁךְ בַּקֶּשֶׁת לְתֻמּוֹ וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּין הַדְּבָקִים וּבֵין הַשִּׁרְיָן וַיֹּאמֶר לְרַכָּבוֹ הֲפֹךְ יָדְךָ וְהוֹצִיאֵנִי מִן־הַמַּחֲנֶה כִּי הָחֳלֵיתִי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπέτεινεν εις τὸ τόξον εὐστόχως καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν βασιλέα Ἰσραὴλ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ πνεύμονος καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ θώρακος· καὶ εἶπεν τῷ ἡνιόχῳ αὐτοῦ Ἐπίστρεψον τὰς χεῖράς σου καὶ ἐξάγαγέ με ἐκ του πολέμου, ὅτι τέτρωμαι.
vulg: unus autem quidam tetendit arcum in incertum sagittam dirigens et casu percussit regem Israhel inter pulmonem et stomachum at ille dixit aurigae suo verte manum tuam et eice me de exercitu quia graviter vulneratus sum
clem: Vir autem quidam tetendit arcum, in incertum sagittam dirigens, et casu percussit regem Israël inter pulmonem et stomachum. At ille dixit aurigæ suo: Verte manum tuam, et ejice me de exercitu, quia graviter vulneratus sum.
kjv: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

wlc: וַתַּעֲלֶה הַמִּלְחָמָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְהַמֶּלֶךְ הָיָה מָעֳמָד בַּמֶּרְכָּבָה נֹכַח אֲרָם וַיָּמָת בָּעֶרֶב וַיִּצֶק דַּם־הַמַּכָּה אֶל־חֵיק הָרָכֶב ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐτροπώθη ὁ πόλεμος ἐν τῇ ἠμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ· καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἦν ἑστηκὼς ἐπὶ τοῦ ἄρματος ἐξ ἐναντίας Συρίας ἀπὸ πρωὶ ἕως ἑσπέρας, καὶ ἀπεχύννετο αἷμα ἐκ τῆς πληγῆς εἰς τὸν κόλπον τοῦ ἅρματος· καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἑσπέρας, καὶ ἐξεπορύετο τὸ αἷμα τῆς τροπῆς ἔως τοῦ κόλπου τοῦ ἅρματος.
vulg: commissum est ergo proelium in die illa et rex Israhel stabat in curru suo contra Syros et mortuus est vesperi fluebat autem sanguis plagae in sinum currus
clem: Commissum est ergo prælium in die illa, et rex Israël stabat in curru suo contra Syros, et mortuus est vespere: fluebat autem sanguis plagæ in sinum currus,
kjv: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.

wlc: וַיַּעֲבֹר הָרִנָּה בַּמַּחֲנֶה כְּבֹא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לֵאמֹר אִישׁ אֶל־עִירוֹ וְאִישׁ אֶל־אַרְצוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἔστη ὁ στρατοκήρυξ δύνοτος τοῦ ἡλίου λέγων Ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ πόλιν καὶ εἰς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γῆν,
vulg: et praeco personuit in universo exercitu antequam sol occumberet dicens unusquisque revertatur in civitatem et in terram suam
clem: et præco insonuit in universo exercitu antequam sol occumberet, dicens: Unusquisque revertatur in civitatem, et in terram suam.
kjv: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.

wlc: וַיָּמָת הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּבוֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן ׃
lxx: ὅτι τέθνηκεν ὁ βασιλεύς. καὶ ἦλθον εἰς την Σαμάρειαν, καὶ ἔθαψαν τὸν βασιλέα ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ.
vulg: mortuus est autem rex et perlatus est Samariam sepelieruntque regem in Samaria
clem: Mortuus est autem rex, et perlatus est in Samariam: sepelieruntque regem in Samaria,
kjv: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

wlc: וַיִּשְׁטֹף אֶת־הָרֶכֶב עַל בְּרֵכַת שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּלֹקּוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־דָּמוֹ וְהַזֹּנוֹת רָחָצוּ כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπένιψαν τὸ αἷμα ἐπὶ τὴν κρήνην Σαμαρείας, καὶ ἐξέλιξαν αἰ ὕες καὶ οἱ κύνες τὸ αἷμα· καὶ αἱ πόρναι ἐλούσαντο ἐν τῷ αἳματι, κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα Κυρίου ὃ ἐλάλησεν.
vulg: et laverunt currum in piscina Samariae et linxerunt canes sanguinem eius et habenas laverunt iuxta verbum Domini quod locutus fuerat
clem: et laverunt currum ejus in piscina Samariæ: et linxerunt canes sanguinem ejus, et habenas laverunt, juxta verbum Domini quod locutus fuerat.
kjv: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the Lord which he spake.

wlc: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אַחְאָב וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּבֵית הַשֵּׁן אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה וְכָל־הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ τῶν λόγων Ἀχαὰβ καὶ πάντα ἃ ἐποίησεν, καὶ οἶκον ἐλεφάντινον ὃν ᾠκοδόμεησεν καὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις ἃς ἐποίησεν, καὶ ἰδοὺ ταῦτα γέγραπται ἐν βιβλίῳ λόγων τῶν πατέρων τῶν βασιλέων Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: reliqua vero sermonum Ahab et universa quae fecit et domus eburneae quam aedificavit cunctarumque urbium quas extruxit nonne scripta sunt haec in libro verborum dierum regum Israhel
clem: Reliqua autem sermonum Achab, et universa quæ fecit, et domus eburnea quam ædificavit, cunctarumque urbium quas exstruxit, nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Israël?
kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

wlc: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אַחְאָב עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲחַזְיָהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη Ἀχαὰβ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐβαςίλευσεν Ὀχοζείας υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ᾿ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: dormivit ergo Ahab cum patribus suis et regnavit Ohozias filius eius pro eo
clem: Dormivit ergo Achab cum patribus suis, et regnavit Ochozias filius ejus pro eo.
kjv: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

wlc: וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אָסָא מָלַךְ עַל־יְהוּדָה בִּשְׁנַת אַרְבַּע לְאַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: Καὶ Ἰωσαφὰθ υἱὸς Ἀσὰ ἐβαςίλευσεν ἐπὶ Ἰουδά· ἒτει τετάρτῳ τῷ Ἀχαὰβ ἐβαςίλευσεν.
vulg: Iosaphat filius Asa regnare coeperat super Iudam anno quarto Ahab regis Israhel
clem: Josaphat vero filius Asa regnare cœperat super Judam anno quarto Achab regis Israël.
kjv: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

wlc: יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה בְּמָלְכוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ עֲזוּבָה בַּת־שִׁלְחִי ׃
lxx: Ἰωσαφὰθ υἱὸς τριάκοντα καὶ πέντε ἐτῶν ἐν τῷ βασιλεύειν αὐτόν, καὶ εἲκοσι καὶ πέντε ἒτη ἐβαςίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ· καὶ ὂνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Ἀζαεβὰ θυγάτηρ Σεμεεί.
vulg: triginta quinque annorum erat cum regnare coepisset et viginti et quinque annos regnavit in Hierusalem nomen matris eius Azuba filia Salai
clem: Triginta quinque annorum erat cum regnare cœpisset, et viginti quinque annis regnavit in Jerusalem: nomen matris ejus Azuba filia Salai.
kjv: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

wlc: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכָל־דֶּרֶךְ אָסָא אָבִיו לֹא־סָר מִמֶּנּוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν πάσῃ ὁδῷ Ἀσὰ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ· οὐκ ἐξέκλινεν ἀπ᾿ αὐτῆς, τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ εὐθὲς ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς Κυρίου·
vulg: et ambulavit in omni via Asa patris sui et non declinavit ex ea fecitque quod rectum est in conspectu Domini
clem: Et ambulavit in omni via Asa patris sui, et non declinavit ex ea: fecitque quod rectum erat in conspectu Domini.
kjv: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the Lord: nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.

wlc: אַךְ הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת ׃
lxx: πλὴν τῶν ὑψηλῶν οὐκ ἐξῆρεν, ἒτι ὁ λαὸς ἐθυςίαζεν καὶ ἐθυμίων ἐν τοῖς ὑψηλοῖς.
vulg: verumtamen excelsa non abstulit adhuc enim populus sacrificabat et adolebat incensum in excelsis
clem: Verumtamen excelsa non abstulit: adhuc enim populus sacrificabat, et adolebat incensum in excelsis.
kjv: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

wlc: וַיַּשְׁלֵם יְהוֹשָׁפָט עִם־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: καὶ εἰρήνευσεν Ἰωσαφὰθ μετὰ βασιλέως Ἰσμραήλ.
vulg: pacemque habuit Iosaphat cum rege Israhel
clem: Pacemque habuit Josaphat cum rege Israël.
kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

wlc: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹשָׁפָט וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה וַאֲשֶׁר נִלְחָם הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה ׃
lxx: καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ τῶν λόγων Ἰωσαφὰθ καὶ αί δυναστεῖαι αὐτοῦ, ὅσα ἐποίησεν, οὐκ ἰδοὺ ταῦτα γεγραμμένα ἐν βιβλίῳ λόγων Ἰωσαφάθ;
vulg: reliqua autem verborum Iosaphat et opera eius quae gessit et proelia nonne haec scripta sunt in libro verborum dierum regum Iuda
clem: Reliqua autem verborum Josaphat, et opera ejus quæ gessit, et prælia, nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro verborum dierum regum Juda?
kjv: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.

wlc: וְיֶתֶר הַקָּדֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאַר בִּימֵי אָסָא אָבִיו בִּעֵר מִן־הָאָרֶץ ׃
vulg: sed et reliquias effeminatorum qui remanserant in diebus Asa patris eius abstulit de terra
clem: Sed et reliquias effeminatorum qui remanserant in diebus Asa patris ejus, abstulit de terra.
kjv: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.

wlc: וּמֶלֶךְ אֵין בֶּאֱדוֹם נִצָּב מֶלֶךְ ׃
vulg: nec erat tunc rex constitutus in Edom
clem: Nec erat tunc rex constitutus in Edom.
kjv: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Eziongeber.

wlc: יְהוֹשָׁפָט עָשָׂר אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ לָלֶכֶת אוֹפִירָה לַזָּהָב וְלֹא הָלָךְ כִּי־נִשְׁבְּרֻה אֳנִיּוֹת בְּעֶצְיוֹן גָּבֶר ׃
vulg: rex vero Iosaphat fecerat classes in mari quae navigarent in Ophir propter aurum et ire non potuerunt quia confractae sunt in Asiongaber
clem: Rex vero Josaphat fecerat classes in mari, quæ navigarent in Ophir propter aurum: et ire non potuerunt, quia confractæ sunt in Asiongaber.
kjv: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.

wlc: אָז אָמַר אֲחַזְיָהוּ בֶן־אַחְאָב אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט יֵלְכוּ עֲבָדַי עִם־עֲבָדֶיךָ בָּאֳנִיּוֹת וְלֹא אָבָה יְהוֹשָׁפָט ׃
vulg: tunc ait Ohozias filius Ahab ad Iosaphat vadant servi mei cum servis tuis in navibus et noluit Iosaphat
clem: Tunc ait Ochozias filius Achab ad Josaphat: Vadant servi mei cum servis tuis in navibus. Et noluit Josaphat.
kjv: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

wlc: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹשָׁפָט עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹרָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπάφη ἐν πόλει Δαυεὶδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ. καὶ ἐβαςίλευσεν Ἰωρὰμ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ᾿ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: dormivitque cum patribus suis et sepultus est cum eis in civitate David patris sui regnavitque Ioram filius eius pro eo
clem: Dormivitque Josaphat cum patribus suis, et sepultus est cum eis in civitate David patris sui: regnavitque Joram filius ejus pro eo.
kjv: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.

wlc: אֲחַזְיָהוּ בֶן־אַחְאָב מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן בִּשְׁנַת שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה לִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁנָתָיִם ׃
lxx: Καὶ Ὀχοζείας υἱὸς Ἀχαὰβ ἐβαςίλευσεν ἐπὶ Ἰσραὴλ ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ ἐν ἒτει ἑπτακαιδεκάτῳ Ἰωσαφὰρ βασιλεῖ Ἰούδα· καὶ ἐβαςίλευσεν ἐν Ἰσραὴλ ἒτη δύο.
vulg: Ohozias autem filius Ahab regnare coeperat super Israhel in Samaria anno septimodecimo Iosaphat regis Iuda regnavitque super Israhel duobus annis
clem: Ochozias autem filius Achab regnare cœperat super Israël in Samaria, anno septimo Josaphat regis Juda: regnavitque super Israël duobus annis.
kjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:

wlc: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אָבִיו וּבְדֶרֶךְ אִמּוֹ וּבְדֶרֶךְ יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ πονηρὸν ἐνατίον Κυρίου, καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν ὁδῷ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ἀχαὰβ καὶ ἐν ὁδῷ Ἰεζάβελ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις οἲκου Ἰεροβοὰμ νἱοῦ Ναβὰτ ὃς ἐξήμαρτεν τὸν Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: et fecit malum in conspectu Domini et ambulavit in via patris sui et matris suae et in via Hieroboam filii Nabath qui peccare fecit Israhel
clem: Et fecit malum in conspectu Domini, et ambulavit in via patris sui et matris suæ, et in via Jeroboam filii Nabat, qui peccare fecit Israël.
kjv: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the Lord God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.

wlc: וַיַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לוֹ וַיַּכְעֵס אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אָבִיו ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐδούλευσεν τοῖς βααλεὶμ καὶ προσεκύνησεν αὐτοῖς, καὶ παρώργισεν τὸν κύριον θεὸν Ἰσραὴλ κατὰ πάντα τὰ γενόμενα ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ. καὶ ἠθέτησεν Μωὰβ ἐν Ἰσραὴλ μετὰ τὸ ὰποθανεῖν Ἀχαάβ.
vulg: servivit quoque Baal et adoravit eum et inritavit Dominum Deum Israhel iuxta omnia quae fecerat pater eius
clem: Servivit quoque Baal, et adoravit eum, et irritavit Dominum Deum Israël, juxta omnia quæ fecerat pater ejus.
